fields.title: Duon'g ni Nying Yesu Kristo
fields.lyrics:
Duon'g ni Nying Yesu Kristo! 
Jo malaika dende; 
Keturu osimbo kuome, 
Kwatime Ruoth chutho. 

Ji mag ogendini duto 
Modak e piny ngima, 
Miyeuru duong' chutho, 
Waleumru ka Ruoth. 
 
Chieng'ma wanabed e polo, 
Wanapodhie nyime, 
Wanapake gi wer pile, 
En e Ruodhwa chutho.

fields.title: Chiembi mar chuny miya,
fields.lyrics:
Chiembi mar chuny miya, 
Koro Yesu. 
Chon ne ipidhoji, 
To wan bende 
Kuom weche mag Nyasaye 
Mokonyowa. 
Chunya riyo mako 
Kuom wach mari. 

Gwedhna weche magi, 
Ruodhwa Yesu, 
Kaka ikonyoji 
Maluwi. 
Ekaigonyona 
Gik motuweya. 
Anayud kwe mara 
Kuomi, Yesu. 

Konya mondo adok 
Japuonj mari, 
Kajoote machon 
E Galili. 
Katichna orumo 
Nalo duto, 
Naneni epolo, 
Yesu Ruodhwa.

fields.title: Ka ma Jawar nothona e Yath
Nikech Nyasaye ogwedha ngan'g
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nikech Nyasaye ogwedha ngan'g,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge;
Kuom herane madwon'g maber,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.

Ok anawe pako Nyinge,
Jawarna, Jawarna;
Ok anawe pako Nyinge,
Osegwedha ahinya ngan'g


2.
Nogolo richona duto,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge;
Dhano machon noguro e yath,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.

3. 
Okonya pile saa mar tem,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge;
To Rembe bende pwodha chuth,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.

4. 
Otega ndalo duto te,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge:
Otelona e yo maber,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge

fields.title: In Maler adiera
fields.lyrics:
1.
In Maler adiera! Wuonwa Nyakalaga!
Koro ka gokinyi wawer kawapaki;
In Maler adiera! In manyalo duto!
Wuonwa, gi Wuode, kod Roho Maler!

2.
In Maler adiera! jo-maler gilami,
Nyaka nene jogo nopaki ka gimor;
Kendo Malaika gini paki chutho,
In nyaka nene, koro, nyaka chieng'

3. 
In Maler adiera! mudho dak gen'gi,
Onge jo maricho maneno duon'gni;
In Maler, In kendi: onge maromo kodi;
Maduong' mawahero, In Maler adier.

4. 
In Maler adiera! Wuonwa Nyakalaga!
Tichni duto mani epiny
ginam gi polo kute;
Duto biro paki, In man'gwon manyalo;
Wuonwa, gi Wuode, kod Roho Maler!

fields.title: Anawer wende Jawarna
fields.lyrics:
1.
Anawer wende Jawarna,
Gi hera ne kuoma.
E musalaba gigure,
Mondo' nogonya e richo.

Weruru, wende Jawarwa,
Kod rembe non'giewo.
E musalaba noweyonwa,
Nochulo gowi, nogonyowa.

2. 
Anahul weche mag Yesu,
Ka nowara e richo.
Gi Herane kod n'gwono,
Nogolo richona te.

3. 
Anapak Yesu Jawar,
Anahul wach tekone.
Omiya teko kuom loyo,
Richo te, gi gik mag piny.

fields.title: Yesu Ruodha gi Jawar miwuoro
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu Ruodha gi Jawar miwuoro,
Ngimana duto achiwo ni;
Amor ahinya e warruokni
Rembi mochwer ogonya koro.

Jawar miwuoro, Jawar miwuoro,
Ibet koda machiegni.
Jawar miwuoro, Jawar miwuoro,
Chunya opong' gi pak magi.

2. 
Gonyo e richo! weche mamit,
Kethruok duto noluoko maler;
Yesu nobiro, odak e hekalu ne,
Gi herane opong'o chunya.

3. 
Yesu, Ruodha, adendoi chutho,
Mwandu mar hera akelo e nyimi;
Telna e yo manyiso duon'gni,
Yomotundo epolo malo.

4. 
Ka watundo dala maler malo,
Abiro neno duon'gni mak rem;
Abiro chalo kodi Jawarna,
Abiro wero wende mag polo.

fields.title: Walamo Jehova Nyasaye
fields.lyrics:
1.
Walamo Jehova Nyasaye
Walami Yesu Kristo
Kod Roho Maler Mar Ruodhwa
Hera mari to duon'g.

2.
Walamo Wuonwa gi Roho,
Omiwa chiemo mar chunywa,
Kod gik moko mabeyo,
Wamiye duong' tinende.

3. 
Walami, Yesu Kristo,
Nosethonwa e Kalvari,
Oluoko chunywa gi rembe,
Wamiye duong' tinende.

4. 
To Roho Maler mar Nyasaye,
Monyisowa marichowa.
Odwaro nyisowa Nyasaye,
Wamiye duong' tinende

fields.title: Nool gweth maduon'g kuomwa
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nool gweth maduon'g kuomwa:
En singruok mar herane,
Wanayudi mew mar Nyasaye,
Mamiyowa mor chutho.

Gweth to nomiwa,
Gweth chuny e mwachando;
Oronwa gweth momedore
E mawakwayo kawuono.

2.
Nool gweth maduon'g kuomwa,
Mar jiwo chunywa kendo;
Jo mool kendo matuo
Giniwinj ni gweth nitie.

3.
Nool gweth maduon'g kuomwa:
Yaye, olnwa koro, Ruoth!
Pong' chunywa gi Roho Maler,
Wachni e moyud duong'.

4. 
Nool gweth maduon'g kuomwa:
To mondo obinwa koro,
Kawahulo richowa duto,
Kwaluongo Nying Yesu.

5. 
Nool gweth maduon'g kuomwa:
Kowayie kendo winjo
Gi ma Ruoth osechikowa
Kawatimo dwaro Mare.

fields.title: Wapaki Nyasaye
fields.lyrics:
1.
Wapaki Nyasaye
Kuom Wuodi mihero,
Kuom Yesu motho,
Mochier, modhi e polo.

Halleluja! Duon'g mari.
Halleluja, amen:
Halleluja! Duon'g mari,
Jiwowa koro.

2. 
Wapaki Nyasaye
Nikech Roho Maler
Monyisowa Jawarwa
Magolo mudho.

3. 
Pak kod duon'g
Kuom Nyarombo Nyasaye
Mosetin'go richowa,
Moluokowa mapoth.

4. 
Jiwowa kendo,
Pon'g chunywa gi hera
Mondo tichwa omoko
Gi mach mar polo.

fields.title: Ka nawinjo Soko nochwer
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ka nawinjo Soko nochwer,
Mar luoko richo duto,
Nayie Roho kopenja,
Idwaro doko maler?

An apake! An apake!
Yesu ma notho kuomwa;
Pakeuru un mon'geyo,
Nirembe e ma luoko richo

2.
Kata yorni obet madiny,
Gik ma yande nahero,
Duon'g kodi ber mar pinyni,
Akwano kagin nono.

3.
Mach mar Nyasaye e mopwodha.
Mojiwo chunya koro,
Ok naweyo pako Nyinge,
Duon'g obedne pile!

4.
Duon'g nobed ni Nying Yesu!
Amor nikech herane.
Moweyona richo duto,
Moluoko chunya maler.

5.
Duon'g, duon'g ni kuom Wuoro!
Duon'g duon'g ni Wuode!
Duon'g, duon'g ni kuom Roho
Gin adek to gin achiel!

fields.title: Ka Jachien otemi
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ka Jachien otemi, kodwaro loyi.
Ka chunyi oani e masicheni:
Par Yesu Ja war ndalo mokonyi.
En nosiri koro, pod oheri.

Kwan gweth magi,
Hul achiel achiel.
Kwan gweth magi,
Kik wiyi owil;
Kwan gweth magi,
Hul achiel achiel,
Yesu osekonyi,
Kik wiyi owil.

2.
Koso in Ja-Kristo man gi chuny mapek?
Tin'go msalabani e wach matek?
Par Yesu Jawarni, chuny mapek noa,
Iniyud mor koro, kata e piny ka.

3.
Kineno jomoko man gi pith mag, piny,
Mwandugi nokadhi ndalo giko piny;
Par Yesu Jawari, Ruodh polo malo,
Gen moloyo Kristo gi pok mosiko.

4.
Kendo e lwenje bed n'gat maber,
Wach mar miriambo lo gi maber;
Yesu ma Jawari gi malaika,
Ginimor moloyo e polo kucha.

fields.title: Telona Nyasaye maduon'g
fields.lyrics:
1.
Telona, Nyasaye maduon'g.
Ka awuotho e piny ka;
An anyap, toin tekona,
Rita kod lueti matek.
Kuon mar polo, miya chiemo
Nyaka ayien'g.

2.
Yawo soko mar ngima
Ka pige machango mol;
Telna gi rumbi polo,
Gi mach, e wuodha duto.
Jares maduon'g, beti koda
Gi teko.

3.
Ka awuotho edho Jordan,
Golo luorona e chunya;
Ting'a malo pige matho.
Nyaka a tund e polo.
Wende mag pako, amiye
Nyaka chieng.

fields.title: An mari Ruodha
fields.lyrics:
1.
An mari, Ruodha, nawinjo duondi
Ka ninyisa herani,
To adwar imedna yie koro,
Kendo suda iri, Ruoth.

Yuwaya buti, buti, Ruoth man'gwon,
Nikech isetho kuoma,
Yuwaya buti, buti, Ruodha maduon'g,
Nikech nichuwero rembi.

2. 
Pwodha koro, Ruoth, mondo atini,
Kuom teko mar ng'wononi.
Mi chunya geno kuomi pile, Ruoth,
Ka gi midwaro,berna.

3. 
Mor opong' chunya pile kabiro
Nyimi kendo iwinja.
Kalami, Nyasacha, man e polo
Wan gi winjruok mar adier.

4. 
Herani matut ok anyal ng'eyo
Nyaka atundi kuro.
Mor mane polo okadho ng'eyo
Anachopi kuom Yesu.

fields.title: Achando kony kuomi
fields.lyrics:
1.
Achando kony kuomi,
Ruodha mang'won;
Onge ma dimiya
Kwe to mana In.

Kony mari e machando;
Achando kony pile!
Gwedha koro, Jawarna,
Abiro iri.

2.
Achando kony mari,
Bed koda, Ruoth;
Tem ok noloya ngang'
Ka In buta.

3.
Rita pile pile,
Ka an-gi mor;
Kata aneno lit,
Bedi koda.

4.
Adwari saa duto,
In Jaler chuth;
Losa abed mari,
Ruodha Yesu.

fields.title: Yesu dak irit chunya
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu, dak irit chunya
Obed kuomi pile.
Kuwo nitie moaye
Soko mar Kalwari.

Kuom Yath ma nogurie
Yesu ma Jawarwa:
En obed pakna pile
E piny kod e polo.

Nanwang'o ng'wono kuome
Ka nayie rembe.
Herane nofwenyore
Ka nothonwa e Yath.

3. 
Mi chunya neno Yesu,
Nyarombo mar Nyasaye.
Naluwe kating'o yath
Kaka nowachonwa.

4. 
Nikech nothonwa e Yath,
An agene chutho,
Nyaka oluonga adhi
Dag e polo malo.

fields.title: Yie na ong'i malo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yie na ong'i malo
Nyaromb mar Kalwari,
Jawar Maler.
Winja ka alami
We kethona duto,
Yie nyaka ndaloni
Abet kodi.

2. 
Ng'wono ni miyo a
Teko kuom chuny mayom,
Medo geno.
Ka isetho kuoma
Hera na amiyi,
Hera mak lokore
Hera maduong.

3.
Ka awuotho e piny
Chandruok omedore
Bedi koda.
Yie mudho lokore,
Ywe piwang'e chunya,
Kik iyie aweyo
Buti pile.

4.
Kawuoth e piny mogik
Tho na ochiegini
Oloyo na.
Jawar e heroni,
Luoro weya
Ting'a gi chuny maler
Ei polo.

fields.title: Nyasachwa In Jakonywa
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nyasachwa, In Jakonywa
Wageni nyaka chien'g.
In luandawa magengonwa,
In thurwa ti mak rum.

2. 
Ee Ruoth nikelo jogi ka,
Niritogi mang'won;
To teko mari e moromo,
To badi osirowa.

3.
Kapok ichweyo piny ginam,
Gi moro podi onge;
To nyaka nene In Nyasaye,
Kamano nyaka chien'g.

4.
Hikwa mathoth e nyim Nyasaye
Gilal ka chieng' achiel,
Gikadho kaka ru mar piny'
To In min'geyowa.

5.
Tondalo piny otero ji,
E piny gidak matin;
To wiyi ok owil kodgi,
Iparogi adier.

6. 
Nyasachwa, In Jakonywa chon,
Wageni nyaka chieng';
Iritowa ka pod wan ka,
In thurwa mak orum.

fields.title: Yesu In misangona
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu, In misangona,
In nitho kuom richona.
Pi gi remo ma nochwer
A e ng'eti, Kalvari,
Chango chunya chutho ka,
Iresa e buch richo.

2. 
Tich mar lueta ok onyal
Romo chikni maradier;
Kata atimo kinda chuth,
Kata ayuagora malit:
Magi ok oresa to
In miresa, In I wuon.

3.
Ok gi moro okonya to
Mana Msalapino.
Denda nono, ruaka Ruoth;
Mia ng'wononi, anyap;
Denda rach, achando pi,
Yesu luoka, kik atho.

4. 
To ka pod angima ka,
Losa kare In I wuon.
Ka naa e pinywa to
Neni e polo cha;
Yesu, In misangona,
In nitho kuom richona.

fields.title: Wuo gi chunya
fields.lyrics:
1.
Wuo gi chunya, Ruoth Yesu,
Nyisa wach kakobet
Ka niwacho gi ng'wono
Ok niweya kenda.
Yaw chunya mondo awinji
Piyo kiwuoyona.
Dhoga to mondo opaki
Kamor kuomi chutho.

Wuo koda ndalo duto
Kinyisa herani
Nimondo alo richo
Ka wuotho kuom Roho.
Wuo koda ndalo duto
Kuom wachni mar ng'wono,
Ageno singruok mari
Ok niweya kenda.

2. 
Wuogi nyithindi pile,
Tergi e yo maler,
Pong'gi kod hera gi mor,
Puonjgi rito lamo
Mondo giwalni chunygi
Kod ngimagi bende
Mondo pinyruodhi obi
Wananeni, Yesu.

3.
Wuokoda koro,Yesu,
Nyisa gi midwaro
Mondo atini pile
Kamako chik duto!
Keta amii duong',
Konya nyiso pakni
Gi mor natim dwaroni
Kaluori pile.

fields.title: Saa mar lamo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Saa mar lamo, e mamorgo,
Omiya yuweyo e chandruok,
Omiya kinde mar nyiso
Wuora gik machando chunya,
Mohoyo chunya kata pek,
Kosira giteko mare,
Maloyogo tem maricho
Katimo kinda kuom lamo.

2.
Saa mar lamo e mamorgo;
Omiyo kwayona duto
Chopo ir Wuora mae polo,
Modwaro gwedha e chunya.
Onyisa mondo asud ire
Kayie Wachne kendo gene,
Oting'ona parruok duto
Katimo kinda kuom lamo.

3. 
Saa mar lamo e mamorgo,
Otega kuom wuodha duto,
Nyaka chieng'moro anadhi
Dala mani e polo cha;
Chandruok duto mag piny orum.
Kaneno Ruodha wang' gi wang',
Mi nabet elerne nyime,
Kapake to kwayo onge.

fields.title: Yesu en Ja konywa
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu en Ja konywa,
En notho kuom richowa,
En odwaro mondo wahul,
Richowa chutho
Wachandore kayiem,
Nikech ok wakway tekone
Nikech wamung'o moko,
Ma ni e chunywa.

2.
Kata wasandore,
Kendo richo dwaro kethowa,
Kwakwayo teko Ruodhwa,
Ere ng'ato man e piny ka
Ma di konywa ka Yesu?
En ong'eyo chunywa duto,
Ber walame pile.

3. 
Ka tekowa onge,
Kendo tich dwaro loyowa,
Yesu dimednwa teko,
Kawakwaye pile,
Ka jo-chiende bembowa,
Kata gikwedore kodwa,
Yesu en osiepwa maduong',
En oherowa ngang

fields.title: Kuom Yesu amiyi chunya
fields.lyrics:
1.
Kuom Yesu amiyi chunya
Miyi chunya duto te;
An aheri, an ageni
An adak kodi pile.

Amiyi chunya
Amiyi chunya,
Kuomi Yesu Jawarna,
Amiyi chunya.

2.
Kuom Yesu amiyi chunya
Apodho e tiendi;
Gik mag pinyni aseweyo
Kawa Yesu kawa te.

3.
Kuom Yesu amiyi chunya
Konya mondo abed kodi:
Nyaka Roho Maler opong'o
Chunya, gi teko mari.

4.
Kuom Yesu amiyi chunya
Ruoth amiyi chunya te;
Pong' chunya gihera mari
Kuom gwethni ariti.

fields.title: Tim dwaroni Ruoth
fields.lyrics:
1.
Tim dwaroni, Ruoth! Tim dwaroni!
In e Jachwech; to an lowo kende.
Chweya kilosa kuom dwaroni.
Kapod arito, kayie adier.

2. 
Tim dwaroni, Ruoth! Tim dwaroni!
Ranga kitema kawuono, Ruoth.
Pwodha girembi, luoka maler,
Kaling'e nyimi kendo ka muol.

3. 
Tim dwaroni, Ruoth! Tim dwaroni!
Chunya otore, konya koro.
Teko duto, Ruoth, e man kuomi;
Mula kichanga, Ja war maler.

4. 
Tim dwaroni, Ruoth! Tim dwaroni!
In mondo iloya, chutho pile;
Pong'a gi Roho mi ji one
Ruoth Yesu kende en ngimana.

fields.title: Nachiwo ngimana
fields.lyrics:
1. 
Nachiwo ngimana, remba nochwer kuomi
Ni mondo owari e tho mar richoni;
Nachiwo ngimana kuomi, to in imiya ang'o?
Nachiwo ngimana kuomi, to in imiya ang'o?

2.
Od Wuora man e polo, gi kom duong' mar loch,
Naweyo kanabiro, e piny ma nosanda;
Kuomi, kuomi naweyogi, ang'o miweyona?
Kuomi, kuomi naweyogi, ang'o miweyona?

3.
Nachandora kuomi, moloyo paroni,
Ka nating'o richoni, nyaka natho e Yath,
Nachandora kama kuomi, ang'o miting'ona?
Nachandora kama kuomi, ang'o miting'ona?

4.
Koro akeloni, gweth moa e polo,
Weruok mar richo duto, warruok gi herana
Akeloni mich madongo, to in imiya ang'o?
Akeloni mich madongo, to in imiya ang'o?

fields.title: Yesu isethona koro aheri
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu, isethona, koro aheri.
Kuom tekoni anawe richo duto
Nikech In Jawarna mang'uon maduong'
Koro Yesu Kristo aheri adier.

2. 
Aheri nikech ihera mokuongo
Nyaka iseting'o richona e yath
Kaka nichandori kuom richo duto
Koro Yesu Kristo aheri adier.

3.
Aheri kangima kata katho
Kendo anapaki ndalo duto ka,
Anaporo pile kuomi, Jawarna.
Koro Yesu Kristo aheri adier.

4. 
Anamii duong' eute polo
Kadhi bedo kodi kuno nyaka chieng'.
Ka wer kod osimbo mar ngima mar Nyasaye,
Koro Yesu Kristo aheri adier.

fields.title: Chunya wuoro kaparo Yath
fields.lyrics:
1.
Chunya wuoro kaparo Yath
Ka ma Ruoth Yesu nothona.
Duto ma an go ni nono,
Ok awinjora gi herane.

2.
Kik apak gi moro ka
Mak mana tho mar Ruoth Yesu.
Gik moko mae piny mahero
Aweyogi nikech rembe.

3. 
Neuru herane kuomwa
Koting'o richowa Owuon.
Ne giketo osimbo kudho
E wi Jawarwa mang'won.

4. 
Mwandu duto ma ni e piny
Nobedo mich matin kuome.
Owinjore achiwone
Chunya gi ngima kod duto.

fields.title: Biuru jo Nyasaye
fields.lyrics:
1.
Biuru jo Nyasaye,
Mohero En adier,
Weruru gi chuny achiel,
Weruru gi chuny achiel,
Kwachokore enyim Nyasaye,
Kwachokore enyim Nyasaye.

Wadhiyo piny Ruodhwa,
Dala maber mar Nyasachwa;
Wachiko wang'wa ni Sayun,
En dala maber mar Nyasaye.

2. 
Jopiny mokiya Nyasaye,
Mondo giling' koro;
To wan nyithinde wanawer,
To wan nyithinde wanawer,
Kwapako Ruodh polo,
Kwapako Ruodh polo.

3.
Nyithindo mag Nyasaye
Gimor gilala ka,
Ka pok gitundo par Nyasaye,
Ka pok gitundo par Nyasaye,
Ka pod giwuotho ka,
Ka pod giwuotho ka.

fields.title: Wang' gi wang' gi Ruoth
fields.lyrics:
1.
Wang' gi wang' gi Ruoth Jawarna,
Wang' gi wang' en manade?
Ka abiro ng'iyo Yesu,
Yesu Kristo nothona.

Wang' gi wang' nabiro ng'iye.
En mabor polo malo.
Wang' gi wang' gi duong' mare,
Nabiro nene kurno.

2.
Koro anene ka ngero,
Eka chieng' mos wang' gi wang'
Koro ang'eyo moro nono,
Eka chieng' moro nane duong'ne.

3. 
Mor maduong' ka wanene,
Ka chandruok maga norum.
Kayore mobam oloko,
Gik momudho orienyna.

4. 
Wang' gi wang' en chieng' mabiro,
Wang' gi wang' ka wang'eye.
Wang' gi wang' kod Jawarna,
Yesu Kristo mohera.

fields.title: Otelona koro amor
fields.lyrics:
1.
Otelona, koro amor,
Nikech Yesu otelona;
Ka madhiye, ka mabetie,
Koro Yesu otelona.

Otelona, otelona,
Yesu Ruodha otelona,
Adwaro luwe gi kinda,
Nikech Yesu otelona.

2. 
Ndalo moro piny orachna,
Ndalo moro piny oberna,
To kata ber, to kata rach,
Koro Yesu otelona.

3. 
Anadwaro mako chinge,
Eka chunya nomor chutho,
Kayieng' gi gik ma nomiya,
Nikech Yesu otelona.

4.
To ka tichna mar piny orumo,
Kuom ng'wonone nadhiye Polo,
Ok analuor kata atho
Nikech Yesu otelona.

fields.title: Ahero nyiso weche
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ahero nyiso weche
Moa kuom Nyasachwa;
Kuom Yesu gi duong'ne,
Kaka noherowa.
Ahero nyiso weche
Nikech gin adiera
Moromo chunya pile
Moloyo duto te.

Ahero nyiso weche,
Mobedo morna pile,
Kahulie weche adier
Kuom hera mar Yesu.

2. 
Ahero nyiso weche,
Ma wuoro ahinya,
Nikech pile kahulo
Chunya omor chutho.
Ahero nyiso weche
Ni ji ma pok omako,
Wechego kuom warruok
Man e kitap Nyasaye.

3.
Ahero nyiso weche
Ni ji moseng'eyo
Ginyalo winjo kendo
Mondo gidongogo.
Ka watundo e polo
Wanawer malong'o,
Weche ma wahero ka
Kuom hera mar Yesu.

fields.title: Nawuotho e yo mar mudho
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nawuotho e yo mar mudho
Nyaka Yesu obi:
Ka gi chieng' mar herane
Nogolo mudho te.

Chieng' rieny, chieng' rieny
E chunya koro,
Chieng' rieny, chieng' rieny
Eyore duto.
Ka Yesu noyuda, golo richona
Angi chieng' mar herane e chuny koro.

2.
Ka boche polo chokore
Gi ahiti uma;
Ka mudho e piny medore,
Angi chieng' e chunya.

3.
Kawuotho e chieng' mar Nyasaye
Alalore kuome;
Aluwo bang'e gi lerne,
A weyo gik mag piny.

4. 
Abiro nene kakobet
E ndalo mabiro;
Abiro nene wang' gi wang'
E polo nyaka chieng'

fields.title: Remb Jawar e ma nochwerna
fields.lyrics:
1.
Remb Jawar e ma nochwerna,
Ka Ruoth noyie tho,
En Maler nochiworena
Ma ok owinjorena.

E kuom Yath mar Yesu nakwongo neno ler,
Ma nogolo richo man e chunya,
Kuom yie rembe ma nochuwerona,
Omiya mor ndalo duto.

2. 
Nikech richo ma natimo,
Nogure e Yadhno,
Chunya wuoro ng'wono ka ma.
En hera mokadho,

3.
Chieng' nolokore ka mudho
Ka Ruoth Polo notho;
En Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasaye
Ma noting'o richo

4.
Yuak gi pi wang' ok dochul
Gowi mar herane;
Chunya e machiwoni, Ruoth,
Abed ng'ati kende.

fields.title: Areto kawuotho e yo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Areto kawuotho e yo
Madhi malo ndalo duto:
Kalamo pile mondo Ruoth
Oting'a malo moloyo.

Ruoth, ting'a malo mond' achung',
Kayie wecheni duto,
Med ting'a malo moloyo,
Abed kapakoi pile.

2. 
Chunya ok gomb siko e piny
Kama chich gi luoro nitie:
To adwaro loyogi te,
E malami ting'a malo.

3.
Adwaro loyo gik mae piny
Ma Jachien diwuondago;
Loch mwaloyogo piny en yie.
Genona ni kuomi pile.

4.
Adwaro bedo motegno
Nyaka ane mor e Polo;
E momiyo pod alami.
"Ruoth, ting'a malo moloyo".

fields.title: Bedi koda piny koro oyusona
An aseyie Yesu Ruoth
fields.lyrics:
1.
An aseyie Yesu Ruoth,
Asingora mondo awuoth,
E yorene mika asetho,
Achope pinje mae polo.

Piny polo ber; piny polo ber,
Ma Yesu miyo joma ler,
Agombo mondo adonjee,
Kama masira ong'eye,
A Yesu Ruoth Ahombi,
Rita mang'won akwayi.

2.
Kaparo gik maseketho,
Ma rohoni osefwenyo,
Chunya ochandore malit,
Miya awinj duondi mamit.

3.
Miyo kapoda ngirna ka,
Kwom richona duto oa,
Miyoni kikawe kedo,
Kodi piny gi gombo gi richo.

4.
Miya akony jowetena,
Alu Jasamaria cha,
Atine ji an ka adwaro,
Mondo gitina kwom duto.

fields.title: Adwaro ng'eyo ka Yesu
fields.lyrics:
1.
Adwaro ng'eyo ka Yesu
Nokecha ka yande nalal,
Omiya ngima mak norum.
Kodi ng'wono amor kode.

Adwaro Wach Yesu,
Adwaro Wach Yesu,
Medna ng'eyo warruok chutho,
Kodi ng'wonone man kuoma.

2.
Wach mar Yesu apuonjora,
Mondo ang'e gi modwaro.
Roho Maler otelona,
En opuonja ndalo duto.

3.
Adwaro somo Wach mare.
Omiya winjruok kod Ruodha
Ka winjo duonde kuom weche.
En nobed maduong, kuoma.

4. 
Adwaro winjo kuom Yesu.
Weche duto mar duong'ne.
Kaka oloyo piny duto.
Ruodh mirembe nowir kendo.

fields.title: Ende wadhiuruwa
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ende wadhiuruwa. Wan joluenj Kristo.
Msalap Ruoth Yesu E modhi nyimwa.
Ruodhwa e motelonwa Ni wasikwa ka;
Ende wadhiuru tinde. Wan joluenj Kristo.

Ende wadhiuru.
Wan joluenj Kristo.
Msalap Ruoth Yesu
E modhi nyimwa.

2.
Ka jo-Kristo timo chir. Jo-Jachien
Wanalo wasigu. Ka wayikore.
To wapak Jatelowa. Mi wamor adier;
Wan jolueny mogeno Yesu.
E momiwa mor.

3.
Pile bedi kodwa ka, Nyiswa yo maber;
Miwa locho chutho Gik matemowa;
Kendo Jomalaika Sirowa e lueny,
Bang'e to iruakwa malo, Paradiso mokwe.

4.
Wan oganda Ruoth Yesu, Joge maradier;
To jo-Kristo duto Gin owetewa;
Ee, wawuotho kaachiel, Ok wapogore;
Wan achiel kuom geno, hera, Tim maler duto.

5.
Kata pinje lokore, Duong' mar piny olal,
To Kanisa Yesu Chweyo nyaka chieng;
Tho gi liel ok nyale ngang'
Luanda mar Yesu;
Ende wadhiuru tinde, Wanjoluenj Kristo.

fields.title: Yesu bed Jakwadhwa
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu, bed Jakwadhwa ndalo duto,
Wachando ritni kuomwa;
Pidh chunywa gi Wachni pile pile.
Losnwa gigi mabeyo.
Wapaki, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Ning'iewowa, wan magi,
Wapaki, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Ning'iewowa, wan magi.

2.
Wan magi, bed kodwa ndalo duto,
Telnwa e yori pile,
Rit kwedhi, geng'wa e richo duto,
Dwarwa di po wabayo.
Wapaki, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Winjwa kod gi mwakwayo,
Wapaki, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Winjwa kod gi mwakwayo.

3. 
Yesu, ihero ruako nyithindo,
Wan gi richo kodi chan,
In gi ng'wono manyalo weyowa,
Luokwa gi rembi maler.
Wapaki, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Konywa mondo walok're.
Wapaki, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Konywa mondo walok're.

4.
Dak igwedhwa ka pod wan nyithindo,
Konywa timo dwaroni.
Ruoth Yesu, In e Jawarwa kende,
Pong' chunywa gi herani. Wapaki,
Ruodhwa Yesu, Iseherowa chutho.
Wapaki, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Iseherowa chutho.

fields.title: Keduru jo ka Yesu
fields.lyrics:
1.
Keduru jo ka Yesu,
Jokedo mar Kristo;
Keluru kuodi magu,
Makuru tong' giluth.
Yesu Jageng'a marwa,
Otelonwa maber;
Weuru uduto luoro,
Keduru ka mager.

2. 
Keduru jo ka Yesu,
Wasigu mawa kwiny;
To Yesu en kokonyowa
Wanyalo loyo en;
Jachien en jasigu,
Madwaro negowa.
Kwaluwo bang' Yesu,
Wabiro hewogi.

3.
Keduru joka Yesu,
Ndalo odong' matin;
Tinende wadhi kedo;
Kiny wadhi weyo lueny;
Mohewo e moyudo
E polo mor mathoth
To higini gi higini,
Osiki kodi Ruoth.

fields.title: Wagenuru singruok duto
fields.lyrics:
1.
Wagenuru singruok duto mag Ruodhwa
Wechene en adier mondo wapake,
Ndalo duto wanamiye duong' ka,
Wanamor kuom weche mag Nyasaye.

Genuru Wach,
Genuru Wach mar Ruodhwa Nyasaye
Jawarwa;
Genuru Wach,
Nikech singruokne en adier chutho.

2. 
Genuru nikech Wachne e mosiko.
Ka chich gi luoro manadi ni kuomi,
Wach mangima mar Nyasachwa oloyo
Wanamor kuom singruok mar Ruodhwa

3. 
Wagenuru singruok duto mag Ruodhwa
Nikech herane wadoko nyithinde,
Kwawuoth kuom ler mar Roho ok waluor
Wanamor kuom weche mag Nyasaye.

4.
Wageneuru singruok duto mag Ruodhwa
Gi teko mar Roho ok wawe geno
Yesu ma Jawar omiyo waloyo,
Wanamor kuom weche mag Nyasaye.

fields.title: Tim kinda mar lamo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Tim kinda mar lamo, kiwuoyo gi Ruoth,
Pidh chunyi gi Wachne kibedo kuome.
Lal'ri gi Jo-Kristo, kony  jogo manyap,
To kik wiyi wil ngang' kuom dwaro gwethne.

2. 
Tim kinda mar lamo, piny kadho piyo,
Bed kode kipondo, kuom Yesu kende,
Ting' wang'i kuom Yesu, ibedi ka En.
Mi ji moko nong'e Yesu nikodi.

3. 
Tim kinda mar lamo, Ruoth oteloni,
Kik iring e nyime, kata ringo chien,
E mor kata chuny lit, luw Yesu pile,
Ket wang'i kuom Yesu, kigeno Wachne.

4. 
Tim kinda mar lamo, opwodho chunyi,
Paro kod tich duto, obedi kuome,
Roho noteloni, nomiyi hera,
Nolosi kuom tichne, e polo malo.

fields.title: Anawer wende malong'o
fields.lyrics:
1.
Anawer wende malong'o,
Kaka noherowa mokwongo,
Kaka nowarowa gi rembe,
Wanamor ei polo nyaka chieng'.

Wanamor nyaka chieng',
Wanamor kawatundo e gweng'no,
Wanamor nyaka chieng
Wanamor kawatundo e polo.

2.
Enochangwa owarwa bende,
Gi remo mar Nyarombone,
Omiyowa mor koro chutho,
Kuom Jakony ma polo nyaka chieng'.

3.
Kawuono omiyo wan gi mor,
Nikech ber mar Jahera nogo,
To kwatundo ire ndalono,
Wanapak Nyinge nyaka chieng'.

4.
Ka watimo kinda e Nyinge,
Nyaka Yesu oduog e piny,
Enoruakwa gi ng'wonone,
Wanamor kode chuth nyaka chieng'.

5.
To nitie kite malong'o,
Mar Jaler onogono,
Mondo ji duto ng'eyo bende,
Konyruok ma ni kuome nyaka chieng'.

fields.title: E chunya nitie wer mamit
fields.lyrics:
1.
E chunya nitie wer mamit
NikechYesu wuoyo koda;
"Kik iluor, antie, abet kodi,"
Wuoth mar ndalo duto te.

Yesu, Yesu, Yesu,
Nying mamitna ngang',
En moroma chutho Pile
En nomia mor

2. 
Ngimana noketho gi richo
Chunya pong' gi sin gi lit ahinya;
Ka Yesu noodonj e chunya
Nogolo richona te.

3. 
Ka wachamo chiembe mar ng'wono
Yweyo e bwo tipo mar buombeni;
Ka ang'iyo pile e wang'e
Chunya bedo gi mor ne.

4. 
Yesu biro duogo omowa
Oa boche polo malo;
Anadhi kode e piny manyien
Analoch kode e polo.

fields.title: Ber kwageno Yesu Kristo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ber kwageno Yesu Kristo,
Kendo wayie kuome pile.
Kawayuweyo kuome pile,
Wawinji maseluwo.

Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasachwa.
Mond ikonyowa ndalo duto,
Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasachwa.
Mad ikonywa ndalo duto.

2.
Ber kwageno Yesu Kristo,
Ka nowewa e richowa.
Med' luoko chunywa duto,
Gi rembe ma nochuwernwa.

3. 
Ber kwageno Yesu Kristo,
En odagi richowa,
Med' gonyowa e richowa,
Gi rembe mosechuwer.

4. 
An adwaro paki pile.
Yesu en osiepna kende,
Mondo' idag e chunya pile.
En aritwa ndalo duto.

fields.title: Tiuru tiuru
fields.lyrics:
1.
Tiuru, tiuru, Wan jotich mag Nyasaye.
Wanalu yo Nyasaye kaka Ruoth osedhi.
Kod wachne gi rieko, momiyowa teko,
Wanati gi teko tich duto wanane.

Tiuru, tiuru, tiuru, tiuru,
Wanagen, wanarit gi lemo,
Gi tiyo nyaka Ruoth obi.

2.
Tiuru, tiuru, mi chiemo kuom jokech.
E soko mar ngima, telo ni jo maojony.
E musalaba gi bendechewa mar duong'.
Ka wahulo weche - "Warruok en nono."

3.
Tiuru, tiuru, tich nitie kuom ji te.
Nikech piny Ruoth mudho gi ketho nopodho.
Gi nyinge mar Nyasaye wanating' a malo.
E weche madongo - "Warruok en nono."

4.
Tiuru, tiuru, tiuru nyaka giko,
Nikech keyo nobi, gi jotich kuom keno.
Gi kar bet mar malo, e dala jo mowar,
Gi weche nyaka chieng' - "Warruoken nono."

fields.title: Lalruok en mamit
fields.lyrics:
1.
Lalruok en mamit, kod Jawarwa
Ka apadora e bede Yesu.
Gweth maduong' nitie, kuome omiyowa
Ka apadora ebede Yesu.

Padori, padori,
Owarowa, oritowa;
Padori, padori,
Padori e bede mosiko.

2. 
Yo mar jawuoth, en wuoth mamit
Ka apadora e bede Yesu.
Yo obedo ler, ndalo duto te
Ka apadora e bede Yesu.

3.
An gi luor ang'o, ka Jawar nikoda,
Ka apadora ebede Yesu.
An gi kwe maduong' ka Ruoth chiegni
Ka apadora e luet Yesu.

fields.title: Kawawuotho gi Ruodhwa
fields.lyrics:
1. 
Kawawuotho gi Ruodhwa
E ler mar wechene,
Mor maduong' momiyowa ka!
Kawatimoni Nyasaye
Gik modwaro duto,
En ogwedhowa gi hawi mare.

Yie gi tim;
Olong'o ni Nyasaye
Okelo mor e chunywa,
Kwageno kuom Yesu.

2. 
Ok wanyal bedo
E mudho mar jo-piny
Nikech hera mar Yesu ni kuomwa.
Ok wayie koro
Kuom lisweche moko
Wayie rembe Yesu kende.

3. 
Onge tuo moro
Kata tho manyalo
Geng'wa kuom hera mar Yesu,
Nikech Yesu nochier, Wan bende moyie
Wan bende moyie,
Wabiro kode kuno.

4.
Wan gi lalruok maber
Kode Jawarwa
Gi lamo kuom Roho mar Nyasaye.
Kwachiwore kuome
Kendo doko jo-tichne
Nopong' chunywa gi mor maduong'.

fields.title: Tiuru Yesu obiro
fields.lyrics:
1.
Tiuru, Yesu obiro,
Kolor e koth polo,
Lunigiuru pile,
Yesu wir' e piny.
Puonjuru wach Yesu,
To mano tich marwa;
Tiuru, Yesu obiro,
Omo jo moyie.

2. 
Tiuru, Yesu obiro,
Tiuru tich maru:
Yesu dwar konyou
Gi teko mare.
Puonjuru wach Yesu,
To mano tich marwa; Tiuru,
Yesu biro, omo jo moyie.

fields.title: Kik yie tem oloyi
fields.lyrics:
1.
Kik yie tem oloyi, Richo dikethi.
In to ked lueny maber, Nyaka ilo.
Tam gombo mar ringruok Kod richo duto.
Teg wang'i kuom Yesu, Nomii loyo.

Kwa Jawar mondo okonyi
Kod tekone moriti;
En to ok oweyi ngang',
Nilo kuome pile.

2.
Pogri joketho, Kik iwuo marach.
Luor Nying Nyasaye pile, Kik wachi kayiem.
Jiwri kuom tim maber, Hul gi ma adier,
Ket chunyi kuom Yesu, Nokonyi chutho.

3. 
Joloyo noyudo osimbo mar duon'g;
Kuom yie e minyalo duto kata tek.
En moseherowa nomiwa teko,
Teg wang'i kuom Yesu nokonyi chutho,.

fields.title: Ilong'o gweth maduong
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ilong'o gweth maduong'
Mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo,
E chunyi gi ngima ni?
Yie kuom singruok mar
Wuoru, Ka onyisi e wachne;
Kaka notimo machon.

Obiro pong'o chunyu gi Roho tinende,
Ka Ruoth osechikou, keluru aguluni;
Obiro pong'o chunyu gi Roho tinende,
Gi Roho Maler gi teko.

2. 
Keluru aguluni ma nono, to ler e rembe,
Biuru un mochando;
Kendo walruok mag dhano
Ka urito enyim kome,
Nyaka Roho Maler oluar.

3. 
Ka mo agulu ok norum,
Ng'wonone obet kama,
Herane ok lokore;
Singruokne osenyisowa e
Roho gi tekone,
Obiro pong'o aguluni.

fields.title: Ruoth e ndalo mar Pentekoste
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ruoth e ndalo mar Pentekoste
Ninyiso tekoni;
Gi mach maler mopuwodho,
Lor kuomwa tinende.

Ruoth oro teko machon,
Teko mar Pentekosti;
Gweth maduong' imiyowa, Imiyowa
Imiyowa te.
Ruoth oro teko machon
Teko mar Pentekosti;
Mondo joricho gilokore
Gi miyo nyingi duong.

2.
Kuom tije madongo watiyoni
Mi chunywa teko duto;
Bi, ikaw jogi iwuon,
Mondo kik giweyi.

3.
Wuo Ruoth wariti e nyim komi
Singruok ni wayie;
Ok wabi weyi nyaka
Wayudo gweth mari.

fields.title: Landuru weche te
fields.lyrics:
1.
Landuru weche te
Kama uyudo ji,
Kama chuny mag dhano
Gi chand dhano betie;
Jokristo duto te
Huluru wach mamor,
Jakony osebiro.

Jakony osebiro, Jakony osebiro,
Roho oa polo, kaka osewacho;
Landuru weche te
Kama uyudo ji, Jakony osebiro.

2. 
Otieno oserumo
Okinyi yawore,
Ahiti bedo kwe
Apaka ling' bende;
Ka piny oyawore
Mudho osekadho
Jakony osebiro.

3.
Ruoth mar Ruodhe maduong
Obi gi buomb chang
Ogonyo jo matweyo
Okelo warruok;
Od twech odong' nono
Winji wende loyo
Jakony osebiro

4.
Hera mar Nyasaye
Lewa onyalo hulo
Ng'wono mar Nyasaye
Kuom jo mabeyo;
Ka an ng'a moketho
Anyalo lokora,
Jakony osebiro.

fields.title: Ka nogik chieng' Pentekoste
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ka nogik chieng' Pentekoste,
Ne nitie jokristo,
Kendo Roho nool kuomgi,
Kaka Yesu nosechiko.

Ruodhwa Yesu, iritwa koro,
Kaka jogi noriti chon;
Kelnwa Roho Maler ahinya,
Opong' chunywa duto.

2.
Ka ne giwinjo duond yamo,
Ka yamo maduong' ngang',
Nobiro ma nopong
E ot ma ne gibetie.

3.
Kendo lep nofweny kuomgi,
Machalo kod mach,
Ma nopong'o ji duto,
Kaka Yesu nosechiko.

4. 
Kendo Roho Maler ahinya
Nopong'o ji duto,
Ne giwooyo gi dhok moko
Kaka Roho omiyogi wacho.

fields.title: Rito kuom Ruoth
fields.lyrics:
1.
Rito kuom Ruoth,
Kuom singruok mar Wuoro;
Rito kuom Ruoth,
Nooro e polo.
Rito kuom Ruoth
Kuom yie wanwang o,
Rito e ot man malo.

Teko mar Roho,
Oloyo richo te,
Gi kelo chuny maler;
Teko mar Roho
Teko chieng' Pentekoste

2.
Rito kuom Ruoth
Miyo Yesu duto;
Rito kuom Ruoth
Nyaka gonya e richo.
Rito kuom Ruoth
Kuom gweth mar polo,
Rito e ot man malo.

3.
Rito kuom Ruoth
Long'o idho malo,
Rito kuom Ruoth
Gombona kuome;
Rito kuom Ruoth
Kuom Mach mar polo,
Rito e ot man malo.

fields.title: Jaduong' moro nobiro
fields.lyrics:
1.
Jaduong' moro nobiro ir Yesu
Mondo openje yo mar odonj e polo;
To Ruoth nodwoke, Adieri onego
Onyuolu nyuol manyien.

Onego onyuolu
Nyuol manyien mar Nyasaye,
Adieri, adieri, onego uyud
Nyuol manyien mar Nyasaye.

2.
Jo machwo gi mamon, winjuru weche Ma
Yesu nowacho gi adieri chutho;
Owachonu kama bende; Onego
Onyuolu nyuol manyien.

3.
Un duto madwaro odonj e polo,
E yuweyo gi mor gi wer mar warruok;
Ngima ma nyaka chieng' niyudi nimar
Nyuol manyien gi Roho.

4. 
Idwaro nenori gosiepe moko
Mosekwongoni dhi e polo mariti?
Kamano yie kuom Yesu, kendo yud
Nyuol manyien gi Roho.

fields.title: Yesu nowara koro ka mor
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu nowara, koro ka mor,
To oseodonj, omenyo chunya,
Koro kadwaro wacho ni ji.
Ok anamung' ngang', ok analing'.

Mano ni morna, mano wenda.
Kapako Nyinge ndalo duto,
Mano ni morna, mano wenda,
Kapako Nyinge ndalo duto.

2.
Yesu nopuonja hero Nyasaye,
Koro kadwaro puonjo ji duto,
Kata gikwero kata giyie,
Ok anamung' ngang', ok analing'.

3. 
Koro kageno Jawarwa,
Yesu ni berna, bende ni lerna,
Ka tichne rumo, ka piny ogik,
Eka nobi ni mondo owara.

fields.title: Kristo Jawarwa notho e yath
fields.lyrics:
1.
Kristo Jawarwa, notho e yath,
Notho kuom joricho, chulo gowi;
Kiro chunyi giremb Nyarombo,
Anakadhi, nakadhi koro.

Ka aneno remo, ka aneno remo,
Ka aneno remo, anakadhi
Nakadhi koro.

2.
Richo madongo, Yesu owara,
Singruokne duto, obiro timo;
Luoko e soko moyawo nu,
Anakadhi, nakadhi koro.

3. 
Bura obiro kuom ji duto,
Ng'ato ka ng'ato ong'ado gi;
Ka upondo e soko remba,
Anakadhi, nakadhi koro.

4. 
En kech maduong', en hera Nyasaye,
Hera gi muolo, gi adieri;
Yudo kwe gi buok e bwo remo,
Anakadhi, nakadhi koro.

fields.title: Isedhi ir Nyarombo Nyasaye
fields.lyrics:
1.
Isedhi ir Nyarombo Nyasaye,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer,
Kata kethruok dich e chunyi manade,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

Noluoki gi rembe,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer,
Kata kethruok dich e chunyi manade,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

2. 
Isedhi ir Yesu Kristo Jakonywa,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer;
Rembe e moromo mana ji duto,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

3.
Isedhi irYesu Kristo Jagwedhwa,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer;
Enoyie ni mond' idonji e polo,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

4.
Kethni duto ni mond ihul ni Nyasaye,
Mondo oluoki gi remb Ruoth Yesu;
Mondo omiyi ngimane ma nyaka chieng',
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

fields.title: Nabiro ir Yesu gi chuny malit
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nabiro ir Yesu gi chuny malit.
Nogolo richona, nogolo richona.
Hera ni maduong' omiyo amor.
Nogolo richona.

Nogolo richona, nogolo richona,
Orita ndalo duto.
Amor ahinya nikech noresa,
Nogolo richona.

2. 
Richo mapek ok nanyalo ting'o,
Nogole kuoma, nogole kuoma.
Koro akelo parona kuome,
Nogolo richona.

3. 
Koro bura oonge e chunya,
Nogolo richona, orita pile.
Kwe mare nomiya e chunya,
Nogolo richona.

4. 
Kiyie biro ir Yesu tinende,
Nogolo richoni, nogolo richoni.
Nomiyi mor e yo miwuotho go,
Nogolo richoni.

fields.title: Bi Roho mar Nyasaye
fields.lyrics:
1.
Bi Roho mar Nyasaye,
Bi konyowa duto,
Walami kawuono,
Konywa gi tekoni.

Roho mar Nyasaye,
Bi, changwa duto,
Walami kawuono.
Gedie chunywa ndalo duto.

2. 
Ine Roho mang'won,
Chunywa bende yuakni,
Wadwaro ni mondo ilose,
Ek' wadoko jo Nyasaye.

3. 
Inie Roho mohero,
Chunywa bende Ikony.
In mikelonwa ngima,
Ber wan duto waheri.

4. 
Roho mar Nyasaye bi
Gedie chunywa duto,
Wanabedi kodi e polo
Higini gi higini.

fields.title: Ngwono maduon'g mar Ruoth
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ngwono maduon'g mar Ruoth Yesu,
Oloyo richo gi kethowa,
Nochwero rembe e Kalvari.
Nyarombo Nyasaye e misango.

Ng'wono mar Ruoth,
Moweyo, moluoko richowa
Ng'wono mar Ruoth,
Ng'wono mogolo richo duto.

2.
Richo ochalo ka apaka
Makuyo chuny gi rem maduong'
Ng'wono mar Nyasaye omiyowa
Kwe kuom Yesu mothonwa e yath.

3. 
Richo ok opondo ni Nyasaye,
Ere gi ma nopwodhe chutho?
Ne! Soko mar remb Yesu ochwer.
Onyalo luoki maler koro.

4. 
Onge ng'wono maromo gi ma,
Mochiwoni kuom yie Yesu;
In kidwaro nenori kode
Dak iyie ng'wonone koro?

fields.title: Ndalo mamor ka ayieri
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ndalo mamor, ka ayieri,
Ja war mara gi Nyasacha;
Chunya obedo, chuny mamor
Lando wecheni kuonde te.

Chieng' mamor, chieng' mamor,
Yesu noluoko richona.
Nopuonja rito, gi lamo;
Bedo mamor, ndalo duto.
Chieng' mamor, chieng' mamor,
Yesu noluoko richona.

2.
Oserumo, wach orumo,
Ruoth en mara, to an mare:
Noyuwaya bi aluwe
Gi mor ahulo wechene.

3. 
Koro chunya yweyo kuome,
Chunya noyudo kwe adier.
Koro ok aweyo Ruodha,
Abet kode, gi en koda.

4. 
Asekwong'ora enyim polo,
Akwong'ora ndalo duto.
Nyaka ngima na rum e piny,
Nyaka ochopo saa mar tho.

fields.title: Nowara mi amor kahulo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nowara mi amor kahulo
Nowara gi remb Nyarombo,
Nowara gingwonone maduong'
Koro abed nyathi Nyasaye.

Warruok, warruok!
Nowara giremb Nyarombo;
Nowara, nowara,
Koro abed nyathi Nyasaye.

2. 
Amor nikech Yesu nowara,
Onego apake pile;
Lerne orienyna ndalo duto,
En koda ma ok noweya.

3. 
Aparo kuom Jawarna pile:
Noyie thona mondo owara;
Chunya opong' gi mor ka,
Wach herane e mawero.

4. 
Ang'eyo nanene giduong, ne,
Chieng' ma nobi omo joge;
Otelona kendo orita.
Wachne omiya' mor pile.

fields.title: Weruru weche Nyasaye
fields.lyrics:
1.
Weruru weche Nyasaye,
Weche mamit mar ngima,
Som gi uru pile pile, weche mamit maber,.
To gi puonjowa niya, ni mondo wagen Yesu,

Weche mamit miwinjo ni,
Weche mamit mar ngima,
Weche mamit miwinjo ni,
Weche mamit maber.

2.
Yesu miyo ji duto te,
Weche mamit mar ngima,
Ji moketho winjuru, weche mamit maber,
Yesu omiyo gi nono, gin gi yie kende,

3.
Ok wamung' ni jo piny,
Weche mamit mar ngima,
To gin weche makonyo gi,
Weche mamit maber,
Yesu en Jawargi chieng' nobi noyier gi.

4.
Moseyie weche mamit,
Weche mamit mar ngima,
Moseyie weche mamit,
Weche mamit maber

fields.title: Weruru wach Ruoth Yesu
fields.lyrics:
1.
Weruru wach Ruoth Yesu,
Odwaro jo maricho
Mobayo e yoregi
Mondo ores jo ma nolal

Weruru pile pile
Kristo dwaro jo molal,
Huluru wach malong'o
Kristo ruako jo molal.

2.
Nwang'uru yuweyo kuome,
Gene chuth, wachne adier,
Oyie ruako ji duto
Modwaro warruok kuome.

3.
Bura ok nolo chunya,
Oketa kare kuom yie,
Rembe noluoka maler,
Noweyona richona.

4.
Kristo oyie ruako ji,
Bi ire gi richoni,
Nowari mi nidonji
E ngima gi mor chutho.

fields.title: Kaw nying Yesu kodi pile
fields.lyrics:
1. 
Kaw nying Yesu kodi pile,
In miwuotho e piny ka;
Nomiyi mor kod teko,
Par Nyinge ka midhiye.

Nyinge ber, Nyinge mit!
Nyingeno e genowa;
Nyinge ber, Nyinge mit!
En Yesu mowarowa.

2.
Kaw nying Yesu kodi pile,
En nobed kuot mariti;
Ka tem kod richo obiro,
Lam e nyingeno maler.

3. 
Ee, nyingno maber mar Yesu
Okelo mor e chunywa;
Ka En oruakwa e polo,
Wanawer kuom nying Yesu.

4.
Koro wadendo nying Yesu,
Kwa lame, owinjowa.
Ruoth moloyo ruodhi duto,
En Yesu, jawarwa.

fields.title: Ja thieth maduong' osudo ka,
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ja thieth maduong' osudo ka,
En Yesu ma Jakonywa;
Wachne omiyo chunywa mor,
Yaye, winjuru dwonde.

Wer mamit mar jopolo,
Ka gipako Ruoth Yesu,
Nying' moloyo nying' duto,
Yesu kende, Yesu.

2.
Oseweyoni richoni,
Winji Yesu kowacho;
Chunyi koro obed gi kwe.
Kichiko wang'yor polo.

3. 
Wadend Nyarombono motho;
Koro ayie kuom Yesu.
Ahero nying' mar Jawarna,
Ahero nying'no, Yesu.

4.
Nying'no ogolo richona,
Onge moromo kode;
Chunya mor nade kawinjo
Nying'no maber mar Yesu.

5. 
Koduogo chiwo osimbo
Osimb ngima mar locho -
Eka wanabedi bute,
Wanadend Jawar Yesu.

fields.title: Nitie remo ma nosechwer
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nitie remo ma nosechwer, Ne en remb Immanuel:
Jo maricho koluokree, Gipwodhore maler.
Gipwodhore maler, Gipwodhore maler;
Jo maricho koluokree, Gipwodhore maler.

2.
Jamecho cha e kar thone, Noyudo mor kuome.
To an bende ma ok aler, Noluokna kethna te.
Noluokna kethna te, Noluokna kethna te;
To an bende ma ok aler, Noluokna kethna te.

3.
Remb Nyarombo ma nonegi, Obedo gi teko,
Mar pwodho jogo mogene, Ni kik giketh kendo,
Ni kik giketh kendo, Ni kik giketh kendo;
Mar pwodho jogo mogene, Ni kik giketh kendo.

4.
Nyaka nageno remono Mochwer e Kalvari.
Apako hera mar Jawar, Moherowa kama.
Moherowa kama, Moherowa kama;
Apako hera mar Jawar, Moherowa kama.

5.
Ruoth, kata ng'a marach kama, Kuom ng'wononi
maduong'
Isewara, ilosona Kar bet ma nyaka chieng'.
Kar bet manyaka chieng', Kar bet ma nyaka
chieng'.
Isewara ilosona Kar bet ma nyaka chieng'

fields.title: Ahero winjo Nying Yesu
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ahero winjo Nying Yesu,
Ahero miye duong';
En wenda kod morna pile,
Omitna moloyo.

An ahero Yesu,
An ahero Yesu,
An ahero Yesu,
Nohera mokwongo.

2. 
Nyingno onyisa kuom hera
Jawar ma nothona,
ldo, Rembe e ma nochwerona,
Magolo richona.

3. 
Onyisa kuom gweth mag Wuora
Momiyowa pile,
Kata awuotho e chandruok,
Lerne orienyna.

4. 
Nyingno onyisa kuom Jakony
Man koda ndalo duto,
Kachunya lit ihoya,
Omiya mor pile

fields.title: Onge moro maduong' ka Yesu
Maricho maga di luok gang'o?
fields.lyrics:
1.
Maricho maga di luok gang'o?
Gi remb Yesu kende.
Chunya di luok mapoth gang'o?
Gi remb Yesu kende.

Remo mar Yesu ratego,
Rembe e ma luoka mapoth,
Onge ng'ato machielo,
Remo mar Yesu kende.

2. 
Onge moro ma di luoka mapoth,
Remo mar Yesu kende.
Onge tim ma di konya,
Remo mar Yesu kende.

3. 
Mirima mar Nyasaye orumo gang'o?
Gi remb Yesu kende.
Nanyalo donj i polo gang'o?
Gi Yesu kende

fields.title: Di her yudo gonyruok
fields.lyrics:
1.
Di her yudo gonyruok kuom richoni?
Nitie teko e remb Ruodhwa.
Di her loyo temruok duto pile
Nitie teko e remb Ruoth.

Teko nitie, teko e remo,
E remo mar Ruodhwa,
Teko nitie ma diwar ji,
Mageno remb Yesu Kristo.

2. 
Di her gonyruok kuom sunga gi mbaka
Nitie teko kuom remb Ruodhwa.
Bi mondo oluok e Kalvari,
Nitie teko e remb Ruoth.

3.
Di her bet mapoth pile ka pile?
Nitie teko e remb Ruodhwa.
Richo duto nodunyo e remo,
Nitie teko e remb Ruoth.

4. 
Di her tiyoni Ruoth Yesu Kristo?
Nitie teko gene chutho,
Di her pakoYesu ndalo duto?
Nitie teko e remb Ruoth

fields.title: Di dag kuom Yesu
fields.lyrics:
1.
Di dag kuom Yesu, bende bedo ber gi ler?
Diwuoth kode, e yo moseyiero?
Diyie mondo iting'i, ting' mapek kuome
Yie kuom dwarone kuomi.

Tekone losi kaka odwaro,
Rembe noluoko chunyi gi gonyi;
Herane opong' chunyi, mond ine,
Ber ne nolos dwarone kuomi.

2.
Diyie mondo nogonyi, gi luwo ka luongi?
Ding'eyo kwe chunyi, nikech imiye chuth?
Diyie mondo oresi, mondo kik iduog chien?
Yie kuom dwarone kuomi.

3. 
Diyudo e piny Ruoth polo ka kobet mar kwe,
Diteme kaka okonyi chieng' sandruok?
Diyie tiyo tich maber kaka inyalo?
Yie kuom dwarone kuomi.

fields.title: Nabayo e richo gi sunga
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nabayo e richo gi sunga,
Ka ok nadewo wach Ruoth Yesu;
Ok nang'eyo kaka nothona
E Kalvari.

Herane gi ng'wonone to duong',
Moweyona richona mathoth;
Asenwang'o thuolo e chunya,
E Kalvari.

2. 
Wach Nyasaye nopuonja kuom richo,
Naneno kaka naketho chik;
Bura noloya nyaka nayie
Wach Kalvari.

3. 
Koro asechiwoni Yesu
Giga duto nikech en Ruodha.
Chunya opong' gi mor mawero
Kuom Kalvari.

4.
Hera Nyasaye noloso warruok,
Ng'wonone nokelo kony kuomwa.
Notimonwa winjruok gi remo
E Kalvari.

fields.title: Un mujony mogangore mapek
fields.lyrics:
1.
Un mujony, mogangore mapek,
Twak kode Yesu, twak kode Yesu;
Chuny kuyo, nikech mor oweu,
Twak kode Yesu kende.

Twak kode Yesu, twak kode Yesu,
En e osiep mwang'eyo.
Osiep moro un uonge go
Twak kode Yesu kende.

2.
Pi wenge ochwer mol ahinya,
Twak kode Yesu, twak kode Yesu;
Ungi richo upando ni dhano,
Twak kode Yesu kende.

3. 
Uluor nikech chandruok obiro.
Twak kode Yesu, twak kode Yesu;
Kik uparru kuom kiny mabiro,
Twak kode Yesu kende.

4. 
Chunyu chandore uparo thou,
Twak kode Yesu, twak kode Yesu;
Piny Ruoth polo mabiro ulong'o,
Twak kode Yesu kende.

fields.title: Biuru duto mowinjo
fields.lyrics:
1. 
Biuru duto mowinjo.
Nitie Ruoth mang'won,
Kendo nomiyi yuweyo
Kiyie Wach Mare.
Yie kende, yie kende,
Yie kuom Yesu,
En owari, En owari,
Nowari koro.

2. 
Nikech Yesu nochuwero rembe,
Ogwedhowa koro.
Bi ire mondo oluoki
Eka nidoki mapoth;
Bi ir Yesu, bi ir Yesu,
Koro bi ire,
En owari, En owari,
Nowari koro.

3.
Yesu en e yo gi adier
Moterowae polo,
Yie kuome, kik ideki.
To bed gi hap Nyasaye.
Kik idagi, kik idagi,
Kik idag Yesu,
En owari, En owari,
Nowari koro.

4.
Riwuru kawuono kodwa,
Wadhi e kar duong,
Wadag e piny maber ngang',
Kar mor ma nyaka chieng'.
An agene, an agene,
Ageno Yesu,
En owara, En owara,
Yesu owara.

fields.title: Bi ir Yesu
fields.lyrics:
1.
Bi ir Yesu,
Bi ir Yesu,
Bi ir Yesu koro;
Koro bi ir Yesu,
Bi ir Yesu koro.

2. 
En Jakonyi, etc.

3. 
En giteko, etc.

4. 
Ka idwaro, etc.

fields.title: Biuru ire Yesu Jakony
fields.lyrics:
1.
Biuru ire, Yesu Jakony,
Wechene e monyisowa yo.
Yesu ochungo koro gi ka,
Kowacho, Biuru.

Wanamor to wanamor ngang',
Eka wanasiki gi Yesu:
Yesu Jakonywa oherowa,
Kendo nowarowa.

2. 
Yesu nowacho, Biuru ka,
Un jo majony muting'o mapek,
To kik udeki, winjuru wach;
Ji duto to gibi.

3. 
Paruru kendo, En koro ka;
Winjuru duond mar Ruodhwa maber:
Ochiko duto mondo gibi,
Nyithindo be gibi.

fields.title: Winjuru duond Yesu Kristo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Winjuru duond Yesu Kristo,
Ruodha maber ni en Yesu,
Winjuru Jakonywa Yesu.
En oluongwa, luongwa, waluwe.

Analuwo bang'i, Yesu,
Analuwo bang'i,
Yesu, Analuwo bang'i, Yesu,
En noriti, riti chunya.

2.
Biuru unune yora,
Yoranogo e malong'o,
Luweuru yoranogo,
Ma utundi ira un duto.

3.
Yoranogo eyo madiny,
Mochiko tir chutho pile,
Yoranogo dhi malo,
Ndalo duto nyaka e pinyni.

4.
Yora en e yo mar ngima,
Yora en yo mar mor chutho,
Mor ne ok anorum.
To nosiki kodwa e polo.

fields.title: Paroni guro e musalaba
fields.lyrics:
1.
Paroni guro e musalaba?
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?
Ikwano gik moko gilal kuom Yesu?
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?

Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?
Luoki e remo mochwer?
Bedo maler gi mamuol te?
Owinjore enyim Nyasaye?

2. 
Inyalo loyo ringri gi richo?
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?
Loyo kethruok te oko gi iye?
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?

3. 
Bura onge koro kuom richo?
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?
Yesu en Ruoth mar chunyi koro?
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?o

4.
Tekoni duto Yesu ochiki,
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?
Pile ka pile obet e chunyi,
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?

5.
Koro iwuotho e yo mar polo.
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye?
Chunyi orwako lau makare.
Chunyi kare kuom Nyasaye.

fields.title: Awinjo kiluonga
fields.lyrics:
1.
Awinjo kiluonga,
Ni mondo abi iri,
Iluoka gi rembi maler.,
Mochuwer e Kalvari.

Abiro ni Ruoth,
Abiro iri;
Kageno rembi kende,
Mochuwer e Kalvari.

2.
Kata richona thoth,
Ageno ng'wononi;
Kiluoko chunya dok maler,
Namor kuom tekoni.

3. 
Apako warruokni!
Mobedo kuom ng'wono!
Kuom chiwonwa Yesu Kristo,
Jawar ma nothonwa.

fields.title: Kiol ting'o ting' mar richo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Kiol ting'o ting' mar richo duto,
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi;
Kidwaro wuotho e ngima manyien,
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.

Riwo gi kiawa we,
Koro kik ikwere,
Koro iyaw dhoot,
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.

2.
Kidwaro yudo chunyi maler koro,
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi;
Soko mar luoko en machiegini,
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.

3.
Ka ingi temruok, ka kwe oonge,
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi;
Gimoro ma chuny nitie midwaro,
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.

4.
Kidwaro riwo gi wer mag johawi,
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi;
Kidwaro odonj e dala polo, 
Yie Yesu odonj e chunyi.

5.
Riwo gi kiawa onge,
Koro ok akwere.
Koro ayawo dhoot.
Yesu oodonj e chunya.

fields.title: Kudwaro yudo gonyruok e richo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Kudwaro yudo gonyruok e richo.
Ng'iuru Nyarombo;
Nothonu e Yath mondo owaru;
Notho e Kalvari.

Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
En kende e monyalo warou;
Ng'iuru Nyarombo.

2. 
Jachien kotemu mochando Chuny
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Gi tekone nulo ndalo duto,
Notho e Kalvari

3. 
Chunyu kojok muneno yorni tek.
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Chunyu nomor kuparo
Motho e Kalvari.

4.
E chand manadi kik uluor ngang',
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Yesu noritu ma ok noweu,
Notho e Kalvari.

fields.title: Asebayo e yo mabor
fields.lyrics:
1.
Asebayo e yo mabor
Kuom Ruodhwa Nyasaye.
Chunya nopong' gi tim richo,
Weya koro, Ruoth.

Abiro koro, Ruoth,
Kik aba kendo,
Kuom ng'wononi abiro ni,
Yesu, Jawarna.

2.
Naketho e nyimi mathoth,
Luoka koro, Ruoth,
Kalokora gi chuny malit;
Luoka koro, Ruoth.

3.
Koro aol gi richona.
Luoka gi rembi,
Ka geno herani kuoma,
Abiro iri.

4.
Chunya lit nikech kethona.
Abiro iri.
Medna teko kod geno,
Puodha koro, Ruoth.

fields.title: Yesu oluongou ng'wonone
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu oluongou ng'wonone,
Luongou kawuono, luongou kawuono,
Ang'o mosindo uwinjo wechene?
Ang'o momiyo udeko?

Luongou kawuono, luongou kawuono.
Yesu oluongou, oluongo ji duto kawuono.

2.
Yesu oluongo jo mool, noyuwe,
Luongou kawuono, luongou kawuono;
Biuru ji duto, ubi uyuwe,
Ok oriembou.

3. 
Yesu oritou, biuru kawuono,
Oritou, oritou,
Biuru gi maricho mau kawuono;
Kik udeki.

4.
Yesu osayou, winjuru wechene,
Winjuru kawuono, winjuru kawuono;
Yesu ohero jo moyie,
Ohero ji ngang' ngang'.

fields.title: Chunya ma onge winjruok
fields.lyrics:
1.
Chunya ma onge winjruok,
To mana rembi mosechwer,
Mi koro iluonga abi,
Ee, koro Yesu, abiro.

2.
Chunya ochando ng'wononi,
Kuom golo richona duto,
Rembi kende e moluoka,
Abiro ni, Yesu, koro.

3.
Gi chuny mayom ma ok ikwer,
Ruaki kendo los maler,
Nikech singruok mari ayie,
To koro, Yesu, abiro.

4.
Gi chuny ma herani oyawo,
Mogolo tamruok duto,
Mondo abedi ng'ati kende
Abiro ni, Yesu, koro.

fields.title: Kik iweya mak igwedha
fields.lyrics:
1.
Kik iweya mak igwedha,
Winj yuakna;
Ka pod ilimo ji moko,
Kik ikadha, Ruoth.

Jawar, Jawar,
Winj kwayona,
Ka pod igwedho ji moko,
Kik ikadha, Ruoth.

2.
Mi ayudi ng'wono kuomi,
Kod kwe e chunya;
Kahuloni richo maga,
Luoka gi rembi.

3. 
Ageno tekoni kende
Gi hera mari;
Chang chunya mosekethoni,
Wara gi ng'wono.

4.
In e soko mar pi maber
Makelo ngima;
Onge ng'a maromo kodi,
Manyalo konya.

fields.title: Dhako nomulo riak nangane
fields.lyrics:
1.
Dhako nomulo riak nangane,
Ka nodhine ling'ling',
E kind jo ma nodhiyo ni Ruodhwa,
To nochange ling'ling'.

Ka'mulo riak nangane,
Ek'abiro chango,
To ma e saa mowinjore
Nimondo achangi.

2. 
Nodhine kokirini ahinya,
Chunye noparore,
Yesu nowinjo ni tekone
Noseowuok kuome.

3. 
Yesu nolokore mowachone,
"Nyarwa, dhiyo gi kuwe
To mondo ing'e gi ma nochangi
En mana yieni."

fields.title: Magi gin ndalo mogik
fields.lyrics:
1.
Magi gin ndalo mogik mag piny,
Geno mogwedh nomiwa mor;
En adier biro ne chiegni,
Notiwa, Ruoth mar ruodhe nyaka chieng'

2.
Birone chiegni, birone chiegni,
Gi mor warito duogone,
Da gokinyi, da godhiambo,
Wang'e birone chiegni.

3.
Ranyis ni e polo gi piny,
Gifwenyo birone machiegni;
Joneno mag Nyasaye hulo,
Biro mar Jawarwa ochiegni.

4. 
Jomotho kuom Kristo,
Jogi duto gi biro chier;
Ka okadho e ranga polo,
Nobiro, olosonwa ot e polo.

5.
To wan mangima modong"
Wanarom ni Ruoth e polo;
Genruok ni ok en manono,
Ka wahoyore wawegi gi wach ni.

fields.title: Anamor gi lala ka Yesu nowir
fields.lyrics:
1.
Anamor gi lala ka Yesu nowir,
Anamor gi lala ka Yesu nowir,
Anamor gi lala ka Yesu nowir,
Koterowa e polo.

Koterowa e polo, Koterowa e polo,
Anamor gi lala ka Yesu nowir,
Koterowa e polo.

2.
Wanawer gi ilo ka Yesu nowir,

3.
Wanarom gosiepwa ka Yesu nowir,

4.
Wanayud gir mwandu kaYesu nowir.

fields.title: Amor nikech Wuonwa ni e polo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Amor nikech Wuonwa ni e polo
Onyiswa herane e kitape,
Weche madongo apuonjorago
To maloyo ni Yesu ohera.

Amor nikech Yesu ohera,
En ohera, En ohera.
Amor nikech Yesu ohera
Ohera an bende.

2.
Yesu ohera koro ahere,
Nobiro e piny mondo owara.
Nikech ng'wonone nothona e yath,
Ang'eyo Yesu ohera adier.

3. 
Ageno kuom Yesu pilepile.
Nomiya hawi mare kuom yie.
Jachien ok nyal loya gi tem,
Remo mar Yesu owara chutho.

4. 
Ndalo moro anawer e polo,
Karomo kod Jawarwa kuno.
To anawer wer mamit nyaka chieng'.
Nikech hera maduong'mar Yesu.

fields.title: Yesu chikowa mondo wanyis ji
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu chikowa mondo wanyis ji,
Kaka mach liel ka polo imore,
Ende wadhiuru tero wach maber,
Puonjo pilepile gi Wach Nyasaye.

2. 
Yesu chikowa chako nyiso ji,
Hera mare e momiyo wadhi,
Ende wadhiuru tero wach maber,
Puonjo pilepile gi Wach Nyasaye.

3.
Yesu chikowa eka wati maber,
Nyiso jo ma kia kaka En notho,
Ende wadhiuru tero wach maber,
Puonjo pilepile gi Wach Nyasaye.

4. 
Yesu chikowa mondo wanyis ji,
En to bedo kodwa eka wanyalo dhi,
Ende wadhiuru tero wach maber.
Puonjo pilepile gi Wach Nyasaye.

fields.title: Yesu hera an ma ng'e
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu hera, an ma ng'e;
En nowachonwa ka ma,
Wan nyithindo en odwaro,
Mondo en okonywa.

Yesu ohera, Yesu ohera,
Yesu ohera, nowachonwa kama.

2. 
Yesu ohera; en notho,
Yawo dho rangach polo;
En ogolo richo maga,
En oyiena odonj cha.

3. 
Yesu ohera, en odong'
Koda nyaka chieng' atho;
Ka ahere  kindepiny,
En notera dalane.

fields.title: Yesu dwaro abed taya
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu dwaro abed taya,
Morieny kuome pile;
Atim long'one ndalo duto,
E dala, e skul, e tich.

An taya, an taya,
Yesu dwaro abed taya;
An taya, an taya,
Abed taya mar Yesu.

2.
Yesu dwaro an gi hera,
Gi kinda kuom ji te;
Mondo ji onge' ni,
An nyathine mamor.

3. 
An akwa Yesu okonya,
Mond' chunya obed maler;
Ngima na obed kuom Yesu,
Morieny kuome pile.

4. 
Anabed taya kuom Yesu,
Anyalo ka atemo;
Tiyone pile ka pile,
Nyaka nadag e polo.

fields.title: Yesu kotaya pile
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu kotaya pile,
Orit a mang'won;
An kabedo bute,
Onge gi manyalo luor.
Winje, machalo duonde
Malaika ma wero
Weche mabiro ira,
Weche mamiya mor.

Yesu kotaya pile,
Orit a mang'won;
Ani kabedo bute,
Onge gi manyalo luor.

2. 
Yesu kotaya pile,
Ok anaparora;
Piny ok nyal teroa,
Kata richo ketha;
Kata aparo ndalo,
Ok analuor gi moro;
Kata ane masira,
Chieng' anamor kuno.

3.
An anadhi ka Yesu,
En ma notho kuomwa
Pile ageno Yesu,
Luandana mageng'ona,
Piny pod otimo mudho,
Ka pod awuotho ka;
Piny to norumo piyo,
Eka anadhi kuno.

fields.title: Yesu biro
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu 'biro, Yesu 'biro,
Ni mondo ochok joge,
Joge duto, joge duto,
Moseyie En.

Kaka sulwe mae polo
Mineno gotieno.
Ginibedi gi Yesu
E polo maler.

2.
Enochokgi, enochokgi,
Nyithinde malong'o;
Jo mabeyo, jo mabeyo,
Moseyie En.

3. 
Wan nyithinde, wan nyithinde,
Mohero Jawarwa.
Enoomwa, enoomwa,
Wanadagi kode.

fields.title: Mond Salem
Winjo kaka malaika wer
fields.lyrics:
1.
Winjo kaka malaika wer,
"Duong'ni kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Marembe ni e piny duto
Ka Nyasaye nong'wononwa."
Chunguru gi mor maduong',
Pakuru Nyinge mamit,
Yesu Kristo onyuole
E dala mar Bethlehem.

Winjo ka malaika wer
"Duong' ni kuom Ruoth Yesu."

2. 
Kristo en gi duong' malo,
Kristo en Ruoth mochwere,
Nosebiro kaka dhano
Ka noweyo duong'ne;
To wang'eyo en Nyasachwa,
Duong' obedne pile
Ma nodoko Jagachwa:
Yesu en Emmanuel.

3.
Duong' ni kuom Ruoth mirembi,
Duong' ni Ruoth makare,
Mokelonwa ler gi ngima,
Kochangowa e richo,
Ka nobiro reso jogo
Ma nobedo e mudho;
Nomiyogi tekone

fields.title: Mor ni e piny
fields.lyrics:
1.
Mor ni e piny kuom nyuol Jawar,
En Ruodh pinje duto.
Ruakeuru e chunyu duto
Polo gi piny omor,
Polo gi piny omor,
To polo gi piny omor kuome.

2.
Mor ni e piny; Ruoth oloyo!
Ji duto pake.
Pinje gi gode duto pake
Komiye duong' maber,
Komiye duong' maber,
Komiye, komiye duong' kod pak.

3.
Kik richo loyo piny koro,
To yieru Yesu,
Nobiro reso jo ma nolal,
Kendo nokel hawi,
Kendo nokel hawi,
Nokel hawi ni jo moyie.

4.
Oloyo gadieri chutho!
Ogendini none
Timne makare kod ng'wonone,
Kod herane maduong',
Kod herane maduong',
Herane, hearane maduong' chutho.

fields.title: Biuru un duto
fields.lyrics:
1.
Biuru un duto, mobedo gi kinda,
Wanadhi Bethlehem gi mor e chunywa.
Neuru Ruodhwa, mosebiro e piny.

Biuru ka wapake,
Biuru ka wadende,
Biuru ka walame,
Yesu Ruodhwa.

2.
Jo-malaika wero, wer mamit moloyo,
Ka gikelo weche mabeyo mag polo;
Duong' ni Nyasaye, kod mirimbe nie piny.

3.
Kamano wadendi, Yesu, Jawarwa;
Nyingi obed maduong' nyaka chieng',
Moseelonwa hera mar Nyasachwa.

fields.title: Otieno mokwe
fields.lyrics:
1.
Otieno mokwe! Otieno moling'
Piny olil, sulwe rieny
Loka kama Nyathi oninde,
Jo maler e ma norite mos
Kwe mar polo ni kodgi.
Kwe mar polo ni kodgi.

2.
Otieno mokwe! Otieno maber!
Mudho 'rumo, duto ler;
Jokwath winjo ka malaika wer,
"Haleluyani Ruoth Maduong.
Osenyuolnu Jawar,
Osenyuolnu Jawar."

3.
Otieno mokwe! Mudho onge!
Sulwe rieny, tero ler,
Ajuoke moa yo wuok chieng'
Kelo mich mabeyo ni Nyathi!
En Ruoth Yesu ma Jawar,
En Ruoth Yesu ma Jawar.

4.
Otieno mokuwe! Otieno maber!
Ler mondo orienynwa,
Wanamiye duong' kwawero
Haleluya ni Yesu Ruodhwa!
En Jawarwa maduong',
En Jawarwa maduong'.

fields.title: Jokwath machon kobedo piny
fields.lyrics:
1.
Jokwath machon, kobedo piny,
Ne rito rombegi:
To Malaika mar Nyasaye
Nosudo kod duong'.

2. 
Ka ne giluor, nohoyogi
Mowacho, Kik uluor,
En wach maber makelonu,
Omiyo mor jopiny.

3. 
E dala Daudi, Bethlehem,
Wuod Daudi, Kristo Ruoth,
Onyuolnu: ma e Jakony.
To mani en ranyisi.

4.
Unyalo neno nyathiu
Moa e polo cha:
Onindo kosiko dhok
Koum gi law mayom.

5. 
Jaote to notieko wach,
Oganda be nowuok, Jomalaika
Ne giwer
Kapako Ruoth kama:

6.
Ni Ruoth man malo duong' odok,
Mirimbe kuom jopiny
Ma Ruoth Nyasaye gi ng'wonone
Ohero, nyaka chieng'.

fields.title: Kristo osechier tinende
fields.lyrics:
1.
Kristo osechier tinende: Alleluya!
Chieng' mwamorie, Chieng' mwawalo: Alleluya!
E msalaba chon notho: Alleluya!
Mondo oreswa e masichwa: Alleluya!

2.
Ber wadend gi pak gi wende! Alleluya!
Kristo Ruoth mae polo malo: Alleluya!
Mak noluoro tho gi liel: Alleluya !
Mondo owargo jo maricho: Alleluya!

3.
Kuom masira ma noneno: Alleluya!
Waseyudo konyruok marwa: Alleluya!
Koro oloyo malo cha: Alleluya!
Ka ma malaika werie: Alleluya!

fields.title: Nonindo e i bur
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nonindo e i bur,
Yesu Jawarwa;
Nochier bang' ndalo adek,
Yesu Ruodhwa.

Nochier nowuok e liende
Gi teko mar Nyasaye man Malo,
Nochier ma noloyo tho gi Jachien,
Ongima tinende modak gi joge,
Osechier! Osechier!
Haleluya, Ruoth nochier.

2.
Ne girito liel mar,
Yesu Jawarwa;
Ne girito kayiem,
Yesu Ruodhwa.

3.
Tho ok nohingo Ruoth,
Yesu Jawarwa;
To noriembonwa tho,
Yesu Ruodhwa.

fields.title: Wich ma ne kudho ochwowo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Wich ma ne kudho ochwowo chon
Oyudo koro duong':
Jalocho ma ndalo duto
Olocho nyaka chieng'.

2.
To kar maduong' e polo ku
En Mare kende Owuon;
En Ruoth moloyo ruodhi piny,
Ruodh polo nyaka chieng'.

3.
Omiyo jo ma malo mor
Gi jo modak e piny,
Moelonigi herane,
Mong'eyo nyinge ka.

4.
Omiyogi Yadh thone to
Gi hape mak rum,
To nyingegi gisiko chuth,
Giyudo mor maler.

5.
Osandogi kod Yesu ka,
Giloyo kode ku:
Gihero ng'eyo herane
E hera maokrum.

6.
Yadh tho noting'o okonyowa,
Kata nonege cha:
To joge e mogenogo
Gidende nyaka chieng'.

fields.title: Koro winji duond Jakwadhwa
fields.lyrics:
1.
Koro winji duond Jakwadhwa,
E thim mar mudho kumabor,
Koluongo rombe moselal,
Ma dhi mabor ahinya.

Kelgi ira, kelgi ira,
Kelgi ira a e yo marach,
Kelgi ira kelgi ira,
Kel jo moruenyo ir Yesu.

2.
Ng'a modhi konyo Jakwadhwa,
Konye yudo jo moselal?
Ng'a ma nodhi kelgi ira,
Ka ma giniyud konyruok?

3. 
E mudho winjo ka giyuak,
Oko e got mabor ngang' ngang';
Winji nduond Ruoth kowachoni,
"Dhi dwar rombe ka ma gilalie."

fields.title: Yesu nolo kwonde duto
Yesu luongo nyithindo duto
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu luongo nyithindo duto, odwaro gibi kuome
Ohero nyithindo duto ma nie piny;
Odwaro golo richo waluwe kod yie;
Ohero nyithindo duto te.

Yesu ohero nyithindo duto,
Manie pinje duto te;
Gi wasungu gijoratenge,
Gi Wahindi gi duto,
Odwaro ji duto te.

2. 
En jakwath mag nyithindo,
Ohero nyithindo duto ma nie piny,
En jakonywa man gi teko oriembo nwaricho
Odwaro nyithindo duto te.

3. 
Yesu Ruodhwa, e mokwongo waluwe gi teko,
Omiwa ng'wono mare duto te,
Wawe richo mawa, wagene pilepile,
Ohero waduto te

fields.title: Dwaruru jo molal
fields.lyrics:
1.
Dwaruru jo molal, Jo ma ni e tho;
Kod ng'wono golgiuru e richo.
Gi hera maduong', Chung jo mopodho,
Nyisgini Yesu emanyalo warogi.

Dwaruru jo molal, Jo ma ni e tho;
Yesu ni kod ng'wono Ma diwargi.

2. 
Kata gisekwere, Pod oritogi,
Ka gilokore enoruakgi.
Sagi mondo gibi, Jiwgi gi muolo;
Yesu oweyo richo kuom yie.

3. 
Jachien owuondo Chuny jo maricho;
To Yesu e manyalo resogi.
Osebiro dwaro Jo ma noruenyo,
Mondo okelgi e mor mar Nyasaye.

4. 
Dwaruru jo molal; Osechikowa,
Kendo Ruoth nomii teko pile.
Kelgi eyo madiny, Yuwagi gi kinda,
Nyisgi kuom Yesu mosethonigi.

fields.title: Chuoyo ndalo duto
fields.lyrics:
1.
Chuoyo ndalo duto, chuoyo koth Injili,
Chuoyo wach adiera nyaka chieng' watho.
Keyo e mabiro, piny ochiek gilala,
Wanamor ahinya, wanamor maber.

Keyo biro wuok,
Keyo biro wuok,
Wanamor gilala,
Keyo biro wuok.

2. 
Chuoyo pinje duto, kaa tek ahinya,
Yesu e mochiko to wadhi koro:
Wan gi kinde tinde, kik wanind koro,
Ende wadhiuru chuoyo wach maber.

3. 
Kata en Jachien, e mawuonda nono,
E mamaya chutho jomodagi wach:
To wacho gi kinda, wanatim sinani,
Keyo biro chopo, wanamor maber.

fields.title: Winjuru luong moa gi kumabor
fields.lyrics:
1.
Winjuru luong moa gi kumabor,
"Ornwa ler, Ornwa ler,"
Onego wadhi reso joma nolal;
Kwalando wechene.

Landuru Wach Yesu ma Jawar,
Lerne mond' orieny e piny,
Landuru Wach Yesu ma Jawar,
Lerne mond' orieny ni ji.

2. 
Wasewinjo kaka ikwayo kama,
"Bi loka, ikonywa."
Wanachiwo ni Yesu ngimawa duto,
Kwalando wechene.

3. 
Wanalam mondo ng'wono omedrenwa;
Kawalando wechene,
Hera mar Yesu ojiwowa pile,
Kawalando wechene.

4. 
Kik wajony kwatiyo ni Ruodhwa Yesu.
Kawalando wechene,
Wakano mwandu e polo kuom Yesu,
Kawalando wechene.

fields.title: Wasewinjo wach maber
fields.lyrics:
1.
Wasewinjo wach maber, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
To keyuru wechegi, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Landuru e pinje te, puonjuru ji wach maber,
Ruodhwa e ma chikowa, Yesu ni Jawarwa.

2. 
Weruru pile pile, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Ne otho kendo nochier, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Weruru ni ji matuo, ka gidwaro hewore,
Weruru e kar liete, Yesu ni Jawarwa,

3. 
Chon ne wakia wechegi, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
Koro wan wamor ngang', Yesu ni Jawarwa,
Chon ne wadak e mudho ka, ti waneno ler Nyasaye
E momiyo mudho tur, Yesu ni Jawarwa.

4.
Yaluru e piny ma ka, Yesu ni Ja warwa;
Yaluru e pinje wa, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Kik wadeki, kik waling', nyaka Yesu duogi,
Nyaka ji duto ong'e, Yesu ni Jawarwa.

fields.title: Adwaro odonj e polo
fields.lyrics:
1.
Adwaro odonj e polo,
Adwaro odonj e polo,
Adwaro odonj e polo,
Nabedi gi Nyasaye.

Ka odonj e polo, Nabedi gi Yesu,
Ka odonj e polo, Nabedi gi Nyasaye.

2.
Kudwaro bedo gi Nyasaye,
Kudwaro bedo gi Nyasaye,
Kudwaro bedo gi Nyasaye,
Biuru ir Yesu.

3. 
Kudwaro long'oni Yesu,
Kudwaro long'oni Yesu.
Kudwaro long'oni Yesu,
Tiuru tich Nyasaye.

4. 
Kudwaro tiyo tich Nyasaye,
Kudwaro tiyo tich Nyasaye,
Kudwaro tiyo tich Nyasaye,
Kwauru chuny maler.

5.
Kudwaro yudo chuny maler.
Kudwaro yudo chuny maler.
Kudwaro yudo chuny maler.
Weuru richou.

6. 
Kuyie weyo richou.
Kuyie weyo richou.
Kuyie weyo richou.
Nudonj e polo.

fields.title: Ngwono mawuoro ahinya
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ngwono mawuoro ahinya.
Ma nowara chutho;
Nalal marach, to nonwang'a.
To koro apake.

2.
Nopuonja gi ng'wono bende.
Nyaka chunywa noyie;
Ne oberna ka naneno,
Wach herane kuoma.

3.
Kata awuotho e chandruok,
Kod tem mathoth mag piny;
Kuom ng'wonone oserita.
Ritne e mageno.

4.
Wanapake higini mak rum
Epolo malo cha.
To pod norem wanamiye duong'
Kaka owinjore.

fields.title: Achiwoni Yesu duto!
fields.lyrics:
1.
Achiwoni Yesu duto!
Kata teko ma ango;
Wechena gi timbe duto
Mondo opake pile.

Duto nobed kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Ngimana nobed mare.

2. 
Lueta mondo otim dwarone,
Tienda odhi e yore,
Wang'a none Yesu kende
Dhoga mondo opake.
Duto nobed kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Ngimana nobed mare.

3. 
Nateg wang'a kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Kik gimoro oyuwaya
Chunya to nopare pile Kaka nothona e Yath.
Duto nobed kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Ngimana nobed mare.

4. 
Ng'wono maduong' ma wuoro
Ka Yesu, ma Ruodh Polo
Oluonga jahera mare;
Omiya yuweyo kuome.
Duto nobed kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Ngimana nobed mare.

fields.title: Kik uluor kata uchandoru
fields.lyrics:
1.
Kik uluor kata uchandoru,
Nyasaye doritou;
Beduru but Yesu pile,
Nyasaye doritou.

Nyasaye doritou ndalo duto.
Ka mudhiye, Nyasaye doritou,
Nyasaye doritou.

2.
Ka jo makwer gichandou,
Nyasaye doritou,
Kupuonjo ji gi Wechene,
Nyasaye doritou.

3. 
Gik muchando En domiu.
Nyasaye doritou,
Gik moko maber mukwaye,
Nyasaye domiyou.

4. 
Kata uneno dhier ahinya,
Nyasaye doritou.
Lame gi chunyu ndalo duto.
Nyasaye doritou.

fields.title: Nyaka wanaromre duto te
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nyaka wanaromre duto te,
Ruoth oritu, puonju, konyu,
Ruaku te e kunde chutho;
Ruoth oritu nyaka e polo.

Wananere te, wananere te,
Wananere cha e tiend Yesu;
Wananere te, wananere te,
Ruoth oritu nyaka e polo.

2.
Nyaka wananere duto te;
Bade mondo oumu chutho,
Chiembe be opognu pile,
Ruoth oritu nyaka e polo.

3.
Nyaka wananere duto te;
Ka ukedo gi masiche,
Ruoth obedo gi nyithinde,
Ruoth oritu nyaka e polo.

4. 
Nyaka wananere duto te.
Herane ni kuomwa koro,
Ruoth jageng'aelueny moloyo,
Ruoth oritu nyaka epolo.

fields.title: Mor mar piny ok nyal ywaya
fields.lyrics:
1.
Mor mar piny ok nyal ywaya,
An dabed ka Yesu,
Ber mar pinyni ok notera,
An dabed ka Yesu.

Bed ka Yesu, en wenda,
E kuonde duto pile;
Bedo kaka Ruoth Yesu!
An dabed ka Yesu.

2. 
Temruok duto osegolo,
An dabed ka Yesu;
Mondo atine ndalo duto,
An dabed ka Yesu

3. 
E yore duto mawuothe,
An dabed ka Yesu;
Kalando wechene pile,
An dabed ka Yesu.

4. 
Nyaka chieng' matundo ire,
An dabed ka Yesu;
Mondo owachna, "In jahawi",
An dabed ka Yesu.

fields.title: Awuoro ng'wono mar Nyasaye
fields.lyrics:
1.
Awuoro ng'wono mar Nyasaye,
Mosefwenyorena;
Hera mar Yesu ka notho,
Nowara e richo.

"Ang'eyo Jalo ma aseyie,
To ayie chutho onyalo rito
Ngimana gi chunya duto
Nyaka ndalo nogono."

2.
Awuoro ka nochiwona
Yie ma osewara;
Kendo geno Wachne chutho
Momiya kwe e chunya.

3.
Awuoro ka Roho Maler
Onyiso kuom richo;
Mofwenyo Yesu gi Wachne,
Kokelo yie kuome.

4. 
Awuoro kaka Ruoth nobi
Chieng' moro nooma;
Odiechieng' kata odiwuor,
Mos wanarom kode,

fields.title: Onge gimoro mak aseyudo,
fields.lyrics:
1.
Onge gimoro mak aseyudo,
Ng'wono nomiya nyaka aseyie,
Sunga aweyo, sungore bende,
An jaricho, to ng'wono osewara.

Yesu nowara gi ng'wono,
Yesu nowara gi ng'wono;
Mani ang'eyo, ami Nyasaye duong'
An jaricho to ng'wono osewara.

2. 
Chon an nafuwo, richo notelona,
Nabayo ok naluw yor Nyasaye,
Yesu noyuda, koro amor,
An jaricho, to ng'wono osewara.

3.
Nachwero pi wang', to ok nokonya,
Da onge ng'wono, onego atine;
Richo noloya, aluoro wang' Nyasaye,
An jaricho, to ng'wono osewara.

fields.title: Anawer wende malong'o
fields.lyrics:
1.
Anawer wende malong'o
Kuom Yesu ma nothona,
Noweyo duong'ne e polo
Mondo otho e Kalvari.

Anawer wende miwuoro
Kuom Kristo ma nothona,
Weruru, jo maler duto
Man e polo gi piny ka.

2.
Ka nalal Yesu nonwang'a
Kaka rombo morwenyo,
Gi hera maber moloyo
Ma noduoka e yore.

3. 
Jawarna nowara chutho
Kuom richo ma noloya,
Naketho, luoro nomaka,
To noresa kuom duto.

4. 
Chandruok podi obiro kuoma
Kaneno chuny lit bende,
To Jawarna ok oweya,
Ohoya maber pile.

fields.title: Yesu ruodhwa adwaro chunyi
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu ruodhwa, adwaro chunyi,
Ni mondo osik koda pile pile,
Gol kuoma maricho gi tim duto,
Ma ni e chunya, mopoga kodi.

Luoka mapoth,
Yaye, luoka mapoth,
Nyaka chunya owinjore
Gi chuny mari.

2. 
Yesu Ruodhwa, kik iwe gimoro,
To duny kethona gi rembi chutho,
Ajok kod gik piny ma nono,
Adwaro mor mo a e polo.

3. 
Yesu Ruodhwa, nena ka ma intie,
Kendo konya ni mondo ayik chunya,
Naweyo tim mar ji gi kit piny te,
Koro luoka gi rembi nadok maler.
4.
Yesu Ruodhwa, Ne ariti pile,
Bi ilosna chuny manyien chutho.
Kuom jo mosekwayi ok ikwer,
To luoka mapoth eka nabed maler.

fields.title: Mwandu mar piny nokadhi
fields.lyrics:
1.
Mwandu mar piny nokadhi,
Kod fedha duto te,
To Piny Ruoth e mosiko
E madwaro donje,
Nyinga ni e bugi,
Mar Ruoth Yesu koso?
Mi chunya ng'eyo chutho
Ka nyinga ni kuno.

Koso nyinga nitie
E ebuk Maler
Mar Piny Ruodh Yesu Kristo;
Koso nyinga nitie?

2. 
Richona thoth ahinya.
To awinjo kaka
Remb Yesu e mawaro
Ji duto moyie.
Koro ageno Wachni
Monyiso kuom richo,
"Kata gibedo makwar
Nalokgi ma rachar."

3.
Kamano amor bende
Kageno Wecheni
Kuom udi mani e polo
Milosonwa kar bet.
Richo ok nodonj kuno
Kata ketho moro.
Yesu En e mowara
Ee, nyinga nondiki.

Chorus mar verse 3 ni:
Koro nyinga nitie, (kod kamano)

fields.title: Ka wageno remb Ruodhwa
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ka wageno remb Ruodhwa,
Wan gi ngima moromowa,
Richo mawa noluoko,
Kod rembe ma nochwernwa.

To kuom Yesu wachungo,
En-ye lwandana mangima,
En-ye lwandana mangima.

2.
Katayora otimo mudho,
Konyruokne miyowa teko;
Kata achandora malich,
Kagene pile nokuweya.

3.
Rembe gi singruok gi muma,
Kageno pile, gisira,
Kata gi piny duto norum,
Yesu Ruodhwa e moroma.

fields.title: Wuora ni gi udi gi piny mathoth
fields.lyrics:
1.
Wuora ni gi udi gi piny mathoth,
Mwandu mag pinyni duto ni e luete!
Fedha gi dhahabu gi dhok mabeyo,
Duto mag Wuora,
En gi mwandu mathoth.

An jacham mwandune,
Jacham mwandune!
Kod Yesu Jawarna,
An jacham mwandune.

2.
Wuode mohero, nodoko Jawar.
Nowuotho e piny ka jachan nikech wan;
To koro oloyo e polo gi duong',
Chieng' moro nadhi kar dakna e polo.

3.
Richona mathoth nopoga chutho
Bedo jacham mwandu; To koro amor
Konyuola manyien gi chuny mar Nyasaye
Nyinga nondiki, an nyathi Ruoth polo!

4.
Gik ma ango ka, to kata ginok,
Olosona kar bet malich e polo!
An wendo e pinyni, to pod awero:
"Duong' ni Nyasaye, an nyathi Ruodh polo!

fields.title: Yesu Jawarwa nobiro
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu, Jawarwa, nobiro Bethlehem,
Koweyo duong'ne koruako kitwa,
Kuom mano awuoro apako Nyinge,
Nobiro warowa.
Nobiro warowa, nobiro warowa,
Kuom mano awuoro apako Nyinge,
Nobiro warowa.

2.
Yesu, Jawarwa, nodhi Kalvari,
Nochulo gopwa nogonyo chunya;
Kuom mano awuoro apako Nyinge,
Kotho kuom richowa.
Kotho kuom richowa, kotho kuom richowa.
Kuom mano awuoro apako Nyinge,
Kotho kuomwa, kuomwa

3.
Yesu, Jawarwa, noluonga ire,
Kawuotho e yo marach mar mudho,
Noluonga aming'a gi ng'wonone,
Noluonga gi ng'wono.
Noluonga gi ng'wono, noluonga gi ng'wono,
Noluonga aming'a gi ng'wonone,
Noluonga gi ng'wono.

4.
Yesu, Jawarwa, noduog kendo,
Ma e genowa mamit malong'o,
Ananene kochung' e kor polo,
Kobiro omowa.
Kobiro omowa, kobiro omowa,
Ananene kochung' e kor polo,
Kobiro omowa.

fields.title: Ne onge ot maber kata kitanda
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ne onge ot maber, kata kitanda,
To kisika kende e moyangore;
Ne onge mor maber, ji ok noparo
Ka ne gin e richo, Jawar nobiro.

Yaw chunyi, mi Jawarni
Kar bet modwaro kuomi,
Dipo kitho miwinjo ni,
Onge kar bet mari.

2.
Ji ok nodhi dende, ne ok giparo
Kata nowinjore, gi kulorene.
Nobiro ni joge, to ok giruake,
Duong' ok gimiye, noonge kar bet.

3.
To Nyasaye man malo, nomiye duong'
Ka malaikane wer, kwe ma nikuome.
Jokwath moko bende, gi jo mariek
Nodhi kendo dende; ne giyudo mor.

fields.title: Chon malaika nobiro e piny
fields.lyrics:
1.
Chon malaika nobiro e piny
Gotieno moro maler,
Jokwath ma nekwayo rombe
Nowinjo wer mamit.
"Okwe ni piny,okwe ni ji,
Moa Ruodhwa mang'won.
Wakelonu weche mamor,
Yesu Kristo onyuol."

2.
"Wadhiuru Bethlehem,"
Jokwath nowacho kendgi,
"Mondo wane wachno kaka obet
Ma Ruoth osenyisowa."
"Okwe ni Piny, okwe ni ji,
Moa Ruodhwa mang'won.
Waweronu weche mamor,
Tinde Jakony onyuol."

3.
Ginwang'o min gi nyathine,
Konindo e kund dhok.
Gipako kendo dendo Nyasaye
Ni kech nooro Wuode.
Okwe ni piny, okwe ni ji.
Ma Ruodhwa mang'won.
Wakelonu weche mamor,
Emanuel ni kodwa."

fields.title: Dala Daudi chon gilala
fields.lyrics:
1.
Dala Daudi chon gilala,
Kunde dhok nitie kanyo;
Ka ma min okete nyathine,
Ka ma dhok oninde.
Mariam ne nyinge min,
Yesu ne nyathi mayom.

2. 
To noa e polo kucha,
En moloyo duto cha,
Ot maber to en ok oyudo,
En nobedo nono ka.
Yesu e modak e piny,
Mondo okony adier jopiny.

3.
To nobet nyathi malong'o,
Ma nowinjo wuon gi min,
En Owuon noherogi gilala,
To ne chunye ler adier.
Wun beduru kaka Yesu,
Jo mamuol mawinjo wach.

4.
En nodongo kaka wan to,
En ranyis mwaluwo ka;
To nobet nyathi mochando,
En nomor to kaka wan.
Kendo oparowa kama,
Kendo omor kod wan adier.

5. 
Oko i kul to wananene,
Ka ma dhok oninde:
Wananene to e polo,
Ka Nyasaye Owuon nitie.
En modwaro terowa,
Wan wabed kode kucha.

fields.title: Wakedo gi Jachien
fields.lyrics:
1.
Wakedo gi Jachien kod joge maricho,
Yesu En Ruodhwa, otelonwa maber,
Wadwaro luwo bang'e ndalo duto,
Yesu Jawarwa

Glory, glory haleluya,
Glory, glory haleluya,
Glory, glory haleluya,
Yesu otelonwa

2. 
Ok wanyalo nego ji gi bunde kod luth
Wadonj kod ji gi Wach gi Much Nyasachwa,
Moko yudo ngima nikech gilokore,
Yesu Jawarwa

3.
Kwakedo ka'onyisowa, wanyalo loyo en,
Kwalemo pile pile kodi somo Wach Ngima,
Wanadok matek kuom kedo,
Yesu otelonwa

4.
Adwaro pako Yesu nikech nowaro ji,
Adwaro pako Yesu nikech nogonyo ji,
Adwaro pako Yesu nikech omiyo ji mor,
Yesu Jawarwa

fields.title: Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasaye
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu Kristo, Wuod Nyasaye,
Chon nobiro konyo dhano.
En nonyisogi rieko,
En nochango jo matuo.

Yesu Kristo, Wuod Nyasaye,
Onyisowa, onyisowa rieko.
Yesu Kristo, En e Ruodhwa,
Wanabed nyithinde adier

2. 
Yesu Kristo oloyo duto;
En modwaro konyowa,
Mondo wan wawe gi fuwo,
Mondo chunywa gibed maler.

3. 
Koro wan wayie Yesu;
Kite long'onwa tinende.
Pile pile wanahere,
Wachne wanamak adier.

fields.title: Ahero pako Yesu nikech nowarowa
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ahero pako Yesu nikech nowarowa,
Adwaro miye duong' ndalo duto ka,
Ayie kuom rembe molwoko richo ji,
Amor kuom liswane mosetimo Kalvari.

Yesu oseng'iewa,
Nogolo richowa,
Nomiyowa ngima,
En nowachonwa kama

2.
Ka ng'ato oyie Yesu en odoko ng'a manyien,
Omor kuom teko mar Nyasaye man malo,
Ohero nyiso ji kuom liswane adier,
Ma Yesu nosetimoni ji gi ringre owuon.

3.
Jo moyie Yesu ok nyal dhi e mach,
Noting'ogi e luete ndalo duto ka,
Jachien en wasikgi otemogi matek,
To Yesu en okonyo jo moiko chunygi chuth.

4.
Ndalo moro noomowa gi tung' machien moyuak,
Noterowa e polo wanasik kucha,
Nomiwa ringruok manyien nikech nowach kama,
Adwaro neno Yesu mosewarowa.

fields.title: Yesu nochier nowuok ei bur
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu nochier nowuok ei bur,
Gi teko mar Nyasaye;
Notieko bura mar richo,
Kuom jo moyie rembe.

Winuru, lokuru duto,
Kurito wiro Ruoth.
Chieng' moro En noomwa,
Koterowa e polo.

2.
Ne giruakone kondo
Mar kudho e wiye,
Ka ginyiere ka en e yath
Gi weche maricho.

3.
Jotich mar Yesu nokawo,
Ringre gibo e nanga;
Gikete e bur mosekuny,
Giritogo chierne.

4.
Jorit norito liende,
Ne gikete kidi,
To ka malaika nobiro
Nong'ielo kidino.

5.
Ne ginene ka' odhiyo
E polo malo kucha.
Chieng' moro En noduog kendo
Kaka ginene kodhi.

fields.title: Nyisa weche mag Ruoth Yesu
fields.lyrics:
1.
Nyisa weche mag Ruoth Yesu,
Pidhgi duto e chunya,
Weche mabeyo maloyo
Duto ma wasewinjo.
Nyisa kaka jomalaika
Nower chieng' mar nyuolne.
Marembe kuom ji duto.

2. 
Nyis kuom ndalo ma nodhiyo
E thim ka noriyo kech,
Noteme nikech richowa
To noloyo makare.
Nyis kaka notiyo ni ji
Kodoko Jawar kuomwa.

3. 
Nyisa kaka ne gigure
E Yath koting'o richo,
Kochier mongima tinde.
Wechego puonja herane
Kochandore nikech wan;
Chunya okuyo kang'eyo
Nothona mondo owara.

fields.title: En Ng'awa man e kund dhok
fields.lyrics:
En Ng'awa man e kund dhok,
Ma jokwath olamo cha?

En e Ruoth! To En Jawarwa!
En e Ruoth moloyo duto!
Wanagone chongwa piny,
Pakeuru, Yesu Ruoth.

2. 
En Ng'awa e thim kucha,
Ma Jachien notemo?

3. 
En Ng'awa e dho liel,
Ma nochiero ng'a motho?

4. 
En Ng'awa mathiedho ji,
Ma noyawo wang' jachan?

5. 
En Ng'awa mogur e Yath,
Ma gisando, ma notho?

6.
En Ng'awa mochier maber,
Ma noloyo tho adier?

7. 
En Ng'awa mohera,
Ma nogolo richona?

8. 
En Ng'awa e polo cha,
Ma nobi e piny kendo?

fields.title: Ruoth Yesu Kristo e Jawar
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ruoth Yesu Kristo e Jawar miwuoro,
Jawar maber chutho kuoma;
Nochiwo ngimane mondo owara,
Herane e moritago.

Opando chunya e lwanda mobar,
Momiyo abedo maber;
Opando chunya e tut herane
Ouma gi luete mang'won,
Ouma gi luete mang'won.

2. 
Ruoth Yesu Kristo e Jawar miwuoro,
Ogolona gi mapek kuoma,
Orita mondo kik achwanyra ngang';
Omiya tekone pile.

3. 
Omiya gweth mathoth pile ka pile,
Mopong'a gi morne chutho,
Mapake gi wer gi ilo mar chunya;
Amor gi Jakonyna chutho.

4. 
Chieng' moro notera kadhi e polo,
Nabed kode nyaka chieng';
Kod joge ma noa e pinje duto,
Napake malong'o chutho

fields.title: Yesu rembi ma nosechwer
fields.lyrics:
1.
Yesu rembi ma nosechwer,
Maluoko richona;
Nochwer mondo ayud warruok,
Koa e ng'et Ruoth.

Rembi Ruodhwa, luoko richo
Aluokra abet maber;
Adendo Ruoth, nikech rembe!
Ma nochwerna e Kalvari.

2.
Abedo chwech manyien koro, 
Kuom remono maler:
Dhano machon otho koro,
Angima kuom Yesu.

3.
Awuotho gi ngima manyien,
Mar loyo piny gi keth;
Chunya ler bende wuodha ler
Ka Kristo odak koda.

4.
Ng'wono miwuoro mar Jawar,
Kopwodha gi rembe;
Yesu ma nothona e yath
En Ruoth chunya koro.

fields.title: Ka Yesu ni koda anyalo dhi
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ka Yesu ni koda anyalo dhi,
Kata manade yuda epiny ma mwaloni:
Ka Yesu onge morna orumo,
Ka Yesu ni koda ok anyal luor.

Ka Yesu ni koda, luoro onge na;
Ka Yesu ni koda ok anyal luor.

2.
Ka Yesu ni koda ok naluor chandruok,
Kata tem mang'eny oluoro wang' yora;
En owuon notelna mondo okonya,
Ka Yesu ni koda anyalo loyo.

3. 
Ka Yesu ni koda ok an kenda ngang',
Kata osiepe weya, to en osiepna;
To kata otera e yore malich,
Ka Yesu nikoda to nabed mamor.

4.
Ka Yesu ni koda anawinj luongne,
Kata ochika mondo adhi e pinje mwa;
Mondo apuonj jopinyno warruok kuom rembe,
Ka mochiko anadhi ka wan kode.

fields.title: Wend Jo-Afrika
fields.lyrics:
1.
Jaler aneno Iwenje ng'eny.
Aneno Iwenje ng'eny e kind joler (2)

Yesu kedo wanalo, jahera kedonwa wanalo (2)

2.
Ruoth Yesu manene okedo chon,
Manene oloyo lweny olamonwa (2)

3.
Kata piny lich masiche dongo
To Yesu kedonwa wanalo (2)

4.
Dhumbe tara gogendini duto,
Gikwero akonya moriwo piny (2)

5.
Wende Yesu mwawero sani
Gi nyiso herano mowarowa (2)

6.
Jachien jakinda notemo Ayubu
To Yesu Lwanda notelone (2)

7.
Aweyo mwandu gi duong'na duto
Kahero ngima mohelore (2)

8.
Ageno dala ma Yesu ong'iewo
Nayudi yweyo e paradiso (2)

9.
Jogo duto mowinjo duonde
Nochokgi duto e paradiso (2)

10.
Wanamor gi malaika duto
Manie polo maritowa (2)

fields.title: Ayuak ni Ruodha ka
fields.lyrics:
1.
Ayuak ni Ruodha
Mondo ikonya kaa,
Kuom kethruok duto
Manie piny;
Ok anyal loyo tem
Ka an kenda,
Mak Yesu owuon
Emotelona.

2. 
Ndalo ka ndalo
Otem sudona.,
Ka jachien owuonda
Ni mondo alal:
To ka an kod Yesu
